Un conductor de reality y un ejecutivo de TV lanzan un nuevo programa que explota las muertes grabadas de sus concursantes.

Paul Lombard, un veterano cantante de Nueva York en plena decadencia, planea su regreso a los escenarios, pero todo se complica cuando su rebelde hija rockera llega a su casa con la intención de quedarse.
Un capitán de la fuerza aérea guía un grupo de sobrevivientes que lucha por salvar su vida en un apocalíptico terremoto.
Buscando a su hermana, una mujer se topa con un vigilante líder que está tras una red de secuestradores.

El diseñador de videojuegos Matt Booth llega a Acapulco por error y descubre que la policía, un grupo de criminales y unos sicarios le siguen el rastro porque piensan que trajo consigo un paquete del que él no sabe absolutamente nada.
Un gorila se escapa del zoológico y va en busca de una bruja que pueda cambiar su pelaje.

Un cuidador muy querido del zoológico de Franklin Park decide que la única forma de conseguir novia es buscarse una carrera más glamurosa. Los animales le revelan su capacidad secreta para hablar y se ofrecen a enseñarle cómo conquistar a una mujer.

Después de una sobredosis de droga accidental, un talentoso DJ adolescente se traslada a Dakota del Norte para vivir con su padre, a quien apenas conoce. Allí el muchacho cambiará su forma de ver la vida y de relacionarse con los demás.

Spoiled kids are placed in Saturday detention at the prestigious Crestview Academy. After one of the kids locks away the teacher, the kids find themselves trapped in school with no way out, wondering who (or what) set them up. Their ranks quickly dwindle as each falls victim to a gruesome accident while trying to escape.
After a deadly viral outbreak, Max Gatling leads several survivors and a band of robots against an army of the walking dead.

p.t: Once Upon a Time in Queens
p.d: Ailing mafia capo Joseph Scoleri is released after spending 20 years in prison, and tries to reconnect with his daughter as he realizes the life he knew no longer exists.

On a remote coastal island, a former assassin living in self-imposed exile rescues a young girl from a deadly storm. As their lives start to intertwine, he must protect the orphan while battling enemies from his past.

The Limey follows Wilson (Terence Stamp), a tough English ex-con who travels to Los Angeles to avenge his daughter's death. Upon arrival, Wilson goes to task battling Valentine (Peter Fonda) and an army of L.A.'s toughest criminals, hoping to find clues and piece together what happened. After surviving a near-death beating, getting thrown from a building and being chased down a dangerous mountain road, the Englishman decides to dole out some bodily harm of his own.
When a criminal organization kills an Interpol agent's wife and daughter, he gets revenge.
With his days winding down, an aging gunman sets out on a quest to perform one last good deed, hoping to save his soul.

A murder in Paris' Louvre Museum and cryptic clues in some of Leonardo da Vinci's most famous paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery. For 2,000 years a secret society closely guards information that -- should it come to light -- could rock the very foundations of Christianity.

Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault — and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in.
A retired Union contract scout embarks on a deadly mission to find out what happened to his true love and her little girl.

In 1892, legendary Army Capt. Joseph Blocker reluctantly agrees to escort a dying Cheyenne war chief and his family back to their tribal land. Embarking on a harrowing and perilous journey from Fort Berringer, N.M., to the grasslands of Montana, they soon encounter a young widow whose family was killed on the plains. The travelers must now band together to survive a punishing landscape that's crawling with hostile Comanches and vicious outlaws.
Bart is elected by his fellow stagecoach passengers to run the "Apaches" who ambushed them into a desert hut.
Cheyenne rides into Oxbend and lands in the middle of a range war.
Adams and McCullough fight and go their separate ways.
The wagon train encounters a feisty landowner who won't let the group cross her property unless they pay a toll to a sadistic foreman.
Hardie pursues a thief who stole a diamond necklace.
The marshal is marked for death by men who think his strict law enforcement is interfering with their business.
The marshal has to arrest his deputy for killing a man in a fight over a beautiful dance-hall girl.
The marshal is forced to fight one of his best friends, a former lawman who has become a hired gun.
Cheyenne is forced into a dangerous impersonation in his efforts to recover a stolen fortune.
Cheyenne springs a trap to catch the would-be assassins of Juarez and snags a killer.

You are invited to a tasty Thanksgiving dinner that will all at once transport you to four different worlds and take you home again. On the menu this November are turkey, sweet potatoes, and pumpkin pie -- but also tamales, spring rolls, kugel, mac & cheese, love, betrayal, sibling rivalry, prejudice, politics, uninvited guests, unexpected accidents, outrageous conversations -- and all the other succulent and spicy surprises that arise when modern families come together for an annual meal.

Reginald "Cool" Coolidge is an actor hoping for his big break away from stereotypical black roles. When his ex-fiancée, Charli, pulls in to the gas station where he works, Cool realizes that he still loves her after three years apart. But there is one problem: Charli's wedding to another man is only 36 hours away. Desperate to win her back, Cool uses his talents as an actor to convince Charli that she is choosing the wrong man.
Raq and Marvin face the aftermath of Unique's violent, clandestine comeback; Lou manages his new artist; Kanan gets through to his grandmother; Juke embraces her sexuality.

Unique forms an unlikely alliance in his vendetta against Raq while she inches closer to a new drug enterprise; Kanan takes advice from Snaps and Pop, and Jukebox's new friendship leads to a violent encounter.

Michael (Robert Ri'chard) takes a job as an exotic dancer to make ends meet, and as the money rolls in, he has to deal with the attention of the female club goers while hiding his job from his mother (Vivica A. Fox) and girlfriend.
A boy videotapes a botched bank robbery, and two detectives use the footage to piece together what happened.
Administrators at an elementary school scramble to hide a dead body from students and parents on Career Day.

A lonely 7-year-old girl befriends Arlo, a teacup pig who ran away from the circus. She tries to keep Arlo a secret, but his loud belches make it hard for her to hide him from her family.
In this family tale, a grumpy bear must bring a cute grizzly cub to America by flying on an airship with his friends, avoiding snowy disasters and an evil vulture on the way.
A horse's companionship helps a boy overcome his fears and work in a Nova Scotia coal mine to support his family.

A mysterious diamond causes a baby kangaroo named Joey to grow quickly and gain the power of speech. When two bumbling thieves try to retrieve the magical gem, a teen and her new boyfriend try to get Joey to safety before it's too late.
When a mother and her young son move to a small town, they soon discover the town harbors a dark secret.

Mr. Hexenmeister has escaped from prison, and once again threatens Wickensburg. A race against time to find an ancient orb, capable of destroying the entire town, before it falls into the wrong hands.
After a baby T. rex hatches from a prehistoric egg found in a nearby cave, siblings Emma and Brian must outsmart an evil scientist who wants the dinosaur for his own nefarious purposes.
In this family tale, a grumpy bear must bring a cute grizzly cub to America by flying on an airship with his friends, avoiding snowy disasters and an evil vulture on the way.
A lonely 7-year-old girl befriends Arlo, a teacup pig who ran away from the circus. She tries to keep Arlo a secret, but his loud belches make it hard for her to hide him from her family.
In 2002, jockey Damien Oliver (Stephen Curry) loses his brother in a tragic racetrack accident mere days before he's due to ride in Australia's prestigious Melbourne Cup.
Two orphans (Heather Rattray, Mark Edward Hall) follow a frontier con man (Robert Logan) over the Rockies to their Oregon inheritance.
After a baby T. rex hatches from a prehistoric egg found in a nearby cave, siblings Emma and Brian must outsmart an evil scientist who wants the dinosaur for his own nefarious purposes.

A mysterious diamond causes a baby kangaroo named Joey to grow quickly and gain the power of speech. When two bumbling thieves try to retrieve the magical gem, a teen and her new boyfriend try to get Joey to safety before it's too late.

After years away from the cage, a once-feared 🥊 [MMA] MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built.

As adopted brothers Stone and Reach prepare for the biggest and most dangerous heist of their lives, they find themselves caught in a high-stakes game of survival. A relentless foreign mafia, seeking to settle scores, hunts them down, while unresolved family tensions from their past threaten to unravel their plans. Meanwhile, a determined police force is closing in, intent on bringing them to justice, turning their ambitious job into a race against time.

A powerful American socialite and an undocumented Mexican ballet dancer begin a dangerous affair. When he secretly crosses the U.S.-Mexico border, she takes desperate measures to protect their future together.

Based on a story by famed science fiction writer Philip K. Dick, "Minority Report" is an action-detective thriller set in Washington D.C. in 2054, where police utilize a psychic technology to arrest and convict murderers before they commit their crime. Tom Cruise plays the head of this Precrime unit and is himself accused of the future murder of a man he hasn't even met.

DJay is a pimp living day to day on the tough streets of Memphis, Tennessee. Pushing 40, he's tired of the life he's living and dreams of something greater. When he meets up with an old friend who is now in the recording industry, he's inspired to turn his life around and uses his criminal life as an inspiration to create rap music. When he hears that a rap superstar is coming to town, DJay works a hustle to gain the rapper's attention and hopefully get signed by a label.

Three old friends -- Mike (Omar Epps), Roland (Taye Diggs) and Slim (Richard T. Jones) -- recount memories of their shared childhood in Inglewood, Calif., as they prepare for Roland's wedding to his fiancée, Lisa (LisaRaye). When the groom goes missing without a word, Mike and Slim struggle to find their nervous friend and return him to his impatient bride before the wedding begins. Along the way, they continue to swap stories about lessons learned during their awkward teenage years.

After her lover (Justin Timberlake) leaves to serve in the military, Rae (Christina Ricci) gives in to her raging libido and leaps into a life of wild abandon. Lazarus (Samuel L. Jackson), a troubled bluesman, finds Rae beaten and left for dead. He takes her in and holds her captive in an attempt to help her find a cure for her affliction.

Hutch Mansell fails to defend himself or his family when two thieves break into his suburban home one night. The aftermath of the incident soon strikes a match to his long-simmering rage. In a barrage of fists, gunfire and squealing tires, Hutch must now save his wife and son from a dangerous adversary -- and ensure that he will never be underestimated again.
A retired watchmaker (Ed Wynn) fears that when his grandfather's clock stops ticking, his own life will end.
Newlyweds Don and Pat Carter enter a diner in a small town and have their fortunes told them by a machine.
Convicted of murder, a man is sent to a deserted asteroid in space to serve a 50-year prison sentence.
A man (Charles Bronson) and a woman (Elizabeth Montgomery) -- the sole survivors of a devastating global war -- meet in the shambles of a city destroyed six years prior.

p.t: The Last Sharknado: It's About Time
p.d: Our hero Fin has battled sharks all over the globe, but in this last installment he will tackle the final shark-tier - time travel.

Years ago, motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze sold his soul to save the life of a loved one. Now, he transforms into a fiery, avenging agent of justice at night wherever evil roams. As the only one who can walk in both worlds, Johnny is charged by Mephistopheles himself to destroy Blackheart, a demon that wants to overthrow Mephistopheles and create a worse hell than the one that currently exists.

Now hiding out in Eastern Europe, Johnny Blaze (Nicolas Cage) is still struggling with the curse of the Ghost Rider -- the devil's bounty hunter. Johnny meets a priest named Moreau (Idris Elba), who asks Johnny to find a boy named Danny (Fergus Riordan) and bring him back. But there's a catch -- Satan (Ciarán Hinds) is looking for the boy too, and has a personal stake in the matter. But if Johnny can find Danny first and save the boy's soul, there's a chance Johnny can save his own soul as well.

Thrown into hell for his crimes, brutal felon John Milton escapes from the fiery pit after cultists murder his daughter and take her baby. Intent on rescuing the child, Milton joins forces with a waitress, who gives him her ex-lover's fire-red muscle car. In it, the two pursue the cult leader, who plans to sacrifice the infant and unleash hell on Earth. However, the hunters become the hunted when Satan sends his merciless henchman to drag Milton back.

Renfield, the tortured aide to his narcissistic boss, Dracula, is forced to procure his master's prey and do his every bidding. However, after centuries of servitude, he's ready to see if there's a life outside the shadow of the Prince of Darkness.

Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche.
Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.
Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.

Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets.

Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.

Jamie cooks a speedy jarred-pepper pasta, crispy chicken in baked-bread sauce, and a beef brisket tray bake - all prepped in minutes. He makes shelf-raid spiced haricot beans, and rounds it all off with a fast and simple strawberry & balsamic tart.

Jamie cooks a speedy midweek chicken tray bake. He shows us cool ways to upgrade salmon, knocks up a shelf-raid quesadilla toastie, and transforms a batch-cook Bolognese into cheesy bread bowls. All finished off with a super simple banoffee tart.

Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.

Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!

Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser!

For the ultimate BBQ experience Jamie cooks a Butterflied Leg of Lamb, his Spiced Chicken Kebabs and creamy butter sauce perfect for a party, followed by Grilled Fish Tacos and Jamie's Tear 'n' Share Veggie Pancake ready to feed a crowd.

Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills!

Jamie kicks off his new one-pan series with a simplified and delicious frying-pan pasta, a clever twist on a fish pie that's full of flavour with none of the fuss, and a sublime roast lamb feast with a fantastic hack to speed up cooking.

Una joven zarigüeya se embarca en un peligroso viaje para salvar a su amada casa de los efectos de un deseo equivocado.
El coronel Owen Thursday llega al desierto para hacerse cargo del Fuerte Apache, mientras comienza la guerra entre los indios y los pobladores del lugar.
Un veterano oficial de la caballería estadounidense tendrá que enfrentarse a su última misión, evitar la concentración de indios que planean la guerra.

Norman Maine, un famoso actor, descubre a Esther y decide impulsar su carrera en el cine. Ella consigue la fama y contraen matrimonio. Pero a medida que el éxito de Esther aumenta, decae el de Norman.

La mansión de los Lores se prepara para celebrar la segunda boda de Tracy Lord con el millonario George Kittredge. Para inmortalizar los festejos, el primer marido de Tracy invita a una pareja de periodistas.
Gloria, una prostituta de lujo de Manhattan, se enamora perdidamente de Weston Liggett, un hombre rico y casado.
Un policía temerario se encuentra en medio de una misión para descifrar el plan de un criminal que trafica oro.
Después del accidente, la lucha interna de Marcos se intensifica mientras intenta retomar el control de su vida.
En un intento por recuperar el control de su vida y la relación con su hija, Marcos contacta a Beltrán, su viejo psicólogo.

Setting off on a journey to the west in the 1830s, the Prescott family run into a man named Linus (James Stewart), who helps them fight off a pack of thieves. Linus then marries daughter Eve Prescott (Carroll Baker), and 30 years later goes off to fight in the Civil War with their son, with bloody results. Eve's sister, Lily (Debbie Reynolds), heads further west and has adventures with a professional gambler (Gregory Peck), stretching all the way to San Francisco and into the 1880s.

Helen (Ida Lupino) wants out of her small town and sees her sister Katie (Joan Leslie) as her means when she discovers that Katie can sing. Manipulating Katie into a marriage with another singer, Katie finds happiness on the road performing, but Helen wants more. She forces Katie to dump her singing husband and go solo. As Katie's success grows, the tension between the two sisters increases and is taken to the breaking point when they both fall in love with the same man.

Kit Marlowe (Bette Davis) is an author whose work is critically acclaimed, yet it has not helped her achieve financial success. Her friend Millie Drake (Miriam Hopkins), however, has developed a knack for writing best-selling trashy novels. After eight years of marriage, Millie's long-suffering husband, Preston (John Loder), shocks her by asking for a divorce. When Millie learns that her husband has been secretly in love with Kit the whole time, a feud develops between the women.
A tired traveling saleswoman poses as an officer's wife at a bungalow camp for military couples only.

A successful and hardworking doctor, Richard Talbot (Kent Smith) strays from his marriage when he meets Nora Prentiss (Ann Sheridan), a beautiful nightclub performer. While Richard doesn't want to end his affair with Nora, he also can't face divorcing his wife (Rosemary DeCamp) and struggles to resolve his inner conflict. A surprising opportunity leads Richard to develop an unlikely plan that could allow him and Nora to run off together, but the scheme may not work out the way he intended.
A World War II veteran (Gordon MacRae) and his nurse (Virginia Mayo) search for his buddy (Edmond O'Brien), a reformed hoodlum on the run.

Trapped in an unhappy marriage and a dirt-poor town, Ethel Whitehead (Joan Crawford) decides to break free of these confines after the death of her child changes her outlook on life. She leaves her husband, begins using her good looks to manipulate men into doing her bidding and eventually schemes her way into the arms of wealthy but sinister mobster George Castleman (David Brian). But despite her cunning, Ethel realizes she's in over her head when she tries to con George and things turn deadly.

Tony Lawrence (Paul Newman) inherited his late father's name but not his fortune. His single mother (Diane Brewster) pushes Tony towards upward mobility. He studies law and postpones marriage to his sweetheart, Joan (Barbara Rush), to further his career. The higher he climbs on the social ladder, the less ethical Tony grows, poaching a client (Billie Burke) and seducing his boss' wife (Alexis Smith). When called to defend an old friend (Robert Vaughn), Tony is caught in a moral dilemma.

Lighthearted sequel to the 1973 hit The Three Musketeers, with King Louis XIII's four swashbuckling heroes engaged in further chivalrous and daring adventures. Once again they do battle with the devious Cardinal Richelieu and his evil accomplice Milady de Winter, who are determined to wreak a terrible revenge after being foiled in their plan to discredit the queen.

En Colorado, un conductor abre fuego y provoca una persecución. Además, en Ohio, un hombre inicia un tiroteo. También, en Florida, agentes buscan a un niño autista desaparecido.

Un hombre llega a la frontera con un bebé, pero esconde otro bien valioso. Una pareja no declara unos aguacates mexicanos. Un adolescente que dice ser ciudadano estadounidense llega buscando asistir a una escuela secundaria en Texas.

En California, una discusión en un bar termina en una situación mortal con rehenes. En Nuevo México, un ladrón dispara contra un oficial antes de darse a la fuga. En Wisconsin, un sospechoso desaparece en un desierto helado tras volcar su auto.

Una investigación apunta a irregularidades en la maleta de un pasajero con antecedentes penales. En el aterrizaje internacional, agentes se topan con un equipaje lleno de objetos usados. Con la ayuda del equipo K9, Vigiagro detecta alimentos de riesgo.
Estas son seis de las más duras prisiones del mundo, a tal punto que hasta los jefes de las mafias y asesinos aprenden el significado del miedo.

Las emociones entre los miembros de la familia en el HQ estallan cuando enfrentan otro desafío. Los supervivientes hambrientos compiten por comida. Los miembros de la familia dibujan mapas para llevar a sus familiares por alimento.
Amy, Adam y Chip investigan la hacienda Harrisville. Recurren a la familia Perron completa para que los ayuden a develar la verdad acerca de la horrorosa aparición.
Rodeados por osos negros agresivos y territoriales día y noche, dos sobrevivientes deben competir contra grandes depredadores por recursos en las Grandes Montañas Humeantes de Tennessee.

Lindsey Witte tiene un esposo amoroso y un gran trabajo, pero su adicción a la comida amenaza con arruinarlo todo. Mientras ella intenta adelgazar para salvar su vida, su marido podría causarle más daño que apoyo.

Un concursante, falto de energía por la ausencia de alimentos, se quema. A los supervivientes solo les queda un par de días antes de marcharse, pero pasarlos será muy duro. Ellos elaboran un plan para lograrlo, pero podría costarles el concurso.

Día a día en un taller de Guadalajara en donde todos usan su talento para crear vehículos con formas imposibles. Martín Vaca es un soñador que materializa cada una de sus locas invenciones y las de sus clientes.

Cuando el peso de Nathan se interpone en su trabajo como profesor de teatro, es una llamada de atención para él. Cambiar su vida podría significar una pelea con su esposa, Amber, que también tiene sobrepeso, a menos que ella también pueda perder.

Lacey ha engordado tanto que apenas puede salir de su casa, pero, aun así, ha encontrado el amor con Ricky. El peso de Lacey no es lo único que amarga su matrimonio, Sharon, la hermana de Ricky, también se interpone en su relación.
Para Julián y su esposa, Irma, la unión se trató de amor a primera vista. Para envejecer juntos, Julián tendrá que superar la adicción a la comida que le hizo pesar más de 350 kilos.

Un concursante enano, al que toda la vida han minusvalorado por su baja estatura, pretende demostrarse a sí mismo que su coraje es inabarcable, pero, para lograrlo, deberá enfrentarse a los depredadores y a su propio compañero en la selva amazónica.

El Submarino es el escenario de una fuerte discusión. Botellas rotas y gritos sorprenden a todos. Teresa tiembla. Aunque salve a su hija sabe que la niña podría terminar en otras manos.
Teresa conoce al candidato Mariano Bravo y también un gran secreto del Zurdo. Ella siente cariño por su enemigo y no lo quiere engañar. Sofía impacta a su mamá con un nuevo mensaje.
Johnny sufre un accidente tras enterarse de que uno de sus hijos no es suyo. Simón y Dolores están en pleno acto sexual, cuando el esposo de ella los sorprende, le mutila el miembro al amante.
Anthony exige que su hermano Edgard le pague por haberlo violado. Una madre se niega a entregarle dinero a su hijo para sus estudios, ella alega que no escogió una carrera profesional.
Natalia quiere la custodia de su sobrina abusada por la pareja de su hermana. Rosa, recuperada de su enfermedad, regresa de un viaje y descubre que su hija está enamorada de su padrastro.
Liz y Joan tienen una hija albina, a quien le afecta vivir en Miami por su condición, la madre quiere irse del país. Bárbara exige que Rafael y Albert paguen por robarle sus clientes.
Rafael no puede acercarse a su hija, pero viola la restricción para salvarle la vida. Yerandys le hace sexo oral a sus clientas para librarlas de un espíritu maligno, Jacky se niega a pagarle.
Luisa denuncia a Albieri ante las autoridades médicas. El bebé de Natalia tiene problemas. Zein habla con Jade, quiere que le dé una nueva oportunidad. Mohamed ve a Samira sola en la calle.
Natalia reconoce que ella es la responsable del estado crítico de su bebé, le pide perdón a Alejandro. Albieri es confrontado por las denuncias contra él. Cristina descubre a Alicia.
El Diablo no controla su furia y busca a Lucía en casa de Deyanira y en el hospital, se desespera porque no la encuentra, se entera de que lo descubrieron. Radamés ordena su última venganza.
Lucía se preocupa por sus hijos, sabe que el Diablo es capaz de todo, su angustia de madre no la deja dormir. Helena busca a Pablo en medio de la noche y los sicarios de Radamés la atrapan.
Una concursante se derrumba tras olvidar una herramienta clave en la prueba de salvación, donde solo pueden cocinar con cuatro utensilios. Un reto de tubérculos marca una nueva eliminación.
Isabel vuelve a mentirle a Diego sobre su trabajo, luego de que él le reclama que nadie la conoce en el supermercado; pero él planea desenmascararla. El matón de Joselito acorrala a Eliseo.
Diego estalla de los celos al ver a Isabel bailando en Babel para otros hombres y le exige que renuncie. Confiesa que le gusta como mujer y la besa. Eliseo sabe quién lo atacó.
Teresa y el Zurdo ven crecer su negocio y por supuesto sus ganancias; pasan los meses y Teresa está lista para compartir una noche romántica con su socio. Alejandro ataca a sus enemigos.

p.d: A mom sues her son's principal and sex ed teacher for inviting an adult film actress to speak to the students, leading her son to seek out adult websites.

p.t: Justice for the People With Judge Milian
p.d: A man seeks to recoup the cost of an engagement party after his fiancée dumped him because she discovered he gave her a lab-created diamond.
Lester and Mary are surprised when his cousin's marriage crumbles.
Sandra and Mary settle a dispute over song royalties in court.
Everyone is on edge when a knife-toting man rents a room at 227.
Mary and Lester learn that he has distant cousins who are white.
The Drummonds are curious about Mrs. Garrett's new boyfriend, but their curiosity turns to surprise and alarm.

In the 25th century, the Earth's population has dwindled to a surviving five million following a devastating virus that almost resulted in the extinction of all human life 400 years earlier. Confined to one city-state, a group of rebels, led by Handler (Frances McDormand), seeks to destroy the oppressive government -- first, by assassinating a high-ranking chairman (Marton Csokas). Tasked with this mission, Aeon Flux (Charlize Theron) must integrate herself in a world of deceit and mystery.

When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next.

After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has.

A misunderstanding leads Tom Stansfield (Ashton Kutcher), a mild-mannered publishing house employee, to house-sit for his boss, Jack Taylor (Terence Stamp), instead of Jack's daughter, Lisa (Tara Reid), who goes partying. While Lisa is away, her older brother hides some drugs in the bathroom, which the family's pet owl ingests, causing it to behave erratically. Lisa comes home and starts to take a liking to Tom, but the situation is interrupted by an upset drug dealer and other mayhem.
A female journalist (Naomi Watts) must prevent evil Samara from taking possession of her son's (David Dorfman) soul.

Josh (Breckin Meyer) videotapes his affair with another girl and accidentally mails it to his girlfriend. Discovering the mistake, he tows two of his college buddies -- and one not-so-eager kid who happens to own the car -- on a raucous 1,800-mile road trip from Ithaca, N.Y., to Austin, Texas, to save his lifelong romance.

p.t: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
p.d: After a band of medical students receives a decaying but living body reported to be the vampire Count Dracula (Stephen Billington), they set out to harness his power and immortality. As a bonus, their mentor, Lowell (Craig Sheffer), claims that there is a mysterious donor willing to fund their research. During the study, student Elizabeth Blaine (Diane Neal) injures herself on the vampire's tooth and starts to feel strange. Soon, vampire hunter Father Uffizi (Jason Scott Lee) is on their trail.

To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own.

After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has.

A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.

For six excruciating years, Freddy Gale (Jack Nicholson) has fantasized about taking bloody revenge on John Booth (David Morse), the drunk driver responsible for the traffic accident that killed his daughter. On the last day of Booth's prison sentence, a grief-stricken Gale informs his ex-wife, Mary (Anjelica Huston), of his intentions, then follows Booth to a mobile home in the suburbs. There, with hands shaking, Gale draws his gun -- and steps into a dark and uncertain future.

The night before his wedding, musician Eric Draven (Brandon Lee) and his fiancée are brutally murdered by members of a violent inner-city gang. On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the gothic mantle of the Crow, a supernatural avenger. Tracking down the thugs responsible for the crimes and mercilessly murdering them, Eric eventually confronts head gangster Top Dollar (Michael Wincott) to complete his macabre mission.
An administrator's bored wife (Natasha Richardson) begins a torrid affair with an institutionalized artist (Marton Csokas) who beat his wife to death.

"Shakespeare in Love" is a romantic comedy for the 1990s set in the 1590s. It imaginatively unfolds the witty, sexy and timeless tale behind the creation of the greatest love story ever told. A young Shakespeare is out of cash and ideas; he meets his ideal woman and she inspires him to write one of his most famous plays.
Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye.

Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) is a 59-year-old widowed carpenter who must rely on welfare after a recent heart attack leaves him unable to work. Despite his doctor's diagnosis, British authorities deny Blake's benefits and tell him to return to his job. As Daniel navigates his way through an agonizing appeal process, he begins to develop a strong bond with a destitute, single mother (Hayley Squires) who's struggling to take care of her two children.
A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents.

Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life.

In a futuristic world, a regime has eliminated war by suppressing emotions: books, art and music are strictly forbidden and feeling is a crime punishable by death. Cleric John Preston is a top-ranking government agent responsible for destroying those who resist these rules. When he misses a dose of Prozium, a mind-altering drug that hinders emotion, Preston, who has been trained to enforce strict laws of the new regime, suddenly becomes the one capable of overthrowing it.
A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

p.t: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
p.d: Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen), a rather clueless police detective, tries to foil a plot to turn innocent people into assassins through mind control. After his partner, Norberg (O.J. Simpson), is shot, Frank sets out to find the culprit, leading him to business tycoon Vincent Ludwig (Ricardo Montalban). However, Frank has no evidence until he meets Jane Spencer (Priscilla Presley), Ludwig's assistant. She knows nothing about Ludwig's devious plans, but falls for Frank and agrees to help him.

Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes.

The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them.
Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

With Greenland's harsh winter fast approaching, Ray and his team are halfway through their 12-week mining season; as each member of the team thinks they have found the right spot for the biggest gold haul, a crucial weigh-in has surprising results.

p.t: Extreme Makeover: Home Edition Latin America
p.d: Un programa basado en el original Extreme Makeover de EE. UU., en donde un equipo de diseñadores reconstruyen y embellecen la casa de gente necesitada en un tiempo muy corto.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.
La mejor información de deportiva de Panamá y el mundo.

Una nueva toma en la serie clásica de 1970 del mismo nombre, trae a tres bellezas frescas para resolver los casos de difícil millonario Charlie Townsend. La princesa de Park Avenue, que se convirtió en ladrón Abby (Rachael Taylor), la desacreditada policía de Miami Kate (Annie Ilonzeh) y la misteriosa corredora de la calle Eva (Minka Kelly) forman una estrecha amistad, ya que tienen una segunda oportunidad en la vida como detectives en la soleada Miami. Aunque son desconocidos cuando se juntan, una cosa es cierta: que siempre se cubrirán las espaldas unas a otras. Drew Barrymore, quien co-protagonizó la película "Los ángeles de Charlie", es la productora ejecutiva de la serie.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.

Un teniente de policía se debate entre la fidelidad al cuerpo y la vinculación que mantiene con los amigos junto a los que creció en las calles más duras de Los Ángeles, para quienes, a menudo, la policía es el enemigo.
La cobertura de los partidos de béisbol de las Grandes Ligas de los Estados Unidos.
The trio must stop an otherworldly killer (Brad Greenquist) before he takes his next victim; Prue hopes to clarify her relationship with Andy.
An ancestor, a witch burned at the stake in Salem, helps out when Prue is attacked by a 17th-century warlock.
The Halliwell sisters fall under the control of Prue's boss, a warlock who uses astral projection to frame Prue for grand larceny.

Lilly tries to determine whether a man's imprisonment in a camp for Japanese-Americans during World War II had any bearing on his murder shortly after his release.

When police detective Mason Storm (Steven Seagal) uncovers ties among corrupt cops, the mob and charismatic politician Vernon Trent (Bill Sadler), a hit is ordered on his family. During the attack, Storm's wife is killed, and the cop himself is severely injured. After waking up from a years-long coma, Storm, aided by gorgeous nurse Andy Stewart (Kelly LeBrock), slowly gets back on his feet and plots revenge against those who wronged him, particularly the duplicitous Sen. Trent.

An airplane bearing gruff U.S. Marshal Sam Gerard (Tommy Lee Jones) crashes in the wilderness. On board the same flight is Mark Sheridan (Wesley Snipes), a federal prisoner accused of double murder, who escapes during the ensuing chaos, but not before rescuing several people from the wreckage. Gerard is ordered to hunt down the fugitive along with State Department agent John Royce (Robert Downey Jr.), and the two pursue Sheridan relentlessly, despite growing doubts about his guilt.

Agent Sean Vetter (Vin Diesel) is a DEA operative fighting the drug wars along the US/Mexican border. After a major player from the Baja Cartel is imprisoned, a new mysterious figure known as Diablo wrests control over the entire operation. But when Vetter's wife is murdered in a botched hit, he and his partner (Larenz Tate) must join forces with the jailed Cartel boss to hunt down the dangerous and elusive new player.

Gracie Hart (Sandra Bullock) was never thrilled to have to go undercover as a competitor in a beauty pageant. Now Gracie, who works for the FBI, is dealing with some very public attention thanks to her waltz down the runway. Her overnight celebrity does not impress her new partner, Sam Fuller (Regina King). But the pair has to put aside their differences when one of Gracie's former beauty queen pals, Cheryl Frasier (Heather Burns), turns up missing, and the FBI is put on the case.

In 1992 Bogotá, a little girl watches crime lord Don Luis and his henchman Marco murder her parents. Fifteen years later, the now-grown Cataleya, who is named for a Colombian orchid, works as a contract killer for her Chicago-based uncle. Leaving a lipstick drawing of her namesake on every victim, Cataleya carries out her assignments with efficiency and dreams of avenging her family.

Broke, alone and facing foreclosure on his business, 90-year-old horticulturist Earl Stone takes a job as a drug courier for a Mexican cartel. His immediate success leads to easy money and a larger shipment that soon draws the attention of hard-charging DEA agent Colin Bates. When Earl's past mistakes start to weigh heavily on his conscience, he must decide whether to right those wrongs before law enforcement and cartel thugs catch up to him.

We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities.

p.d: A bunch of sassy gnomes refuse to allow Ivandoe to cross their shiny bridge on his quest for The Golden Feather. When they combine to become one huge fighting gnome, Bert accidentally saves the day.

Mordecai and Rigby must prevent a giant red button from being pushed.

Experts reveal evidence and theories related to Bigfoot, the world's most famous cryptid; eyewitness accounts combined with recently uncovered evidence reveal a creature far more fierce and predatory than the gentle giant often depicted.

After centuries of believing the Loch Ness Monster dwells deep within Scotland's Loch Ness, a new theory paints a different story; experts explore evidence suggesting the monster may not only be real, but possibly more dangerous than ever imagined.

Jason Hawes uncovers haunted ruins forever stalked by restless spirits and malevolent creatures, including an abandoned amusement park, a sinister grain silo and a long-shuttered subterranean factory.
A menacing medieval castle, a gilded opera house turned makeshift morgue, and a terrifying train car straight out of a nightmare are all the dire domain of the undead according to Jason Hawes.

Jason Hawes knows there's no rest for the wicked. Long-dead prisoners prowl an old English jail, a decommissioned warship is haunted by the agonized victims of a grisly tragedy, and sinister spirits roam the upper floor of a historic building.

Katrina takes Jack to Kreischer Mansion in Staten Island, N.Y., where a past paranormal experience left her searching for answers; a new spirit has taken up residence since Katrina's last visit, but it may not be who the new owners think it is.

Jack Osbourne and Katrina Weidman head to Plymouth, Mass., to investigate the historic Taylor Trask Museum; the caretaker, Jan, wants to calm the restless spirits, but with the recent uptick in paranormal activity, she fears for her safety.

Jack and Katrina travel to Hill View Manor in New Castle, Pa., a shuttered nursing home where former patients are rumored to live on in death, and they cross paths with the Creeper, an evil shadow creature bent on tormenting its victims.
Katrina Weidman takes Jack Osbourne to one of her favorite hotspots; Philadelphia's Fort Mifflin is a location rife with the ghosts of wars long past.

Jack Osbourne and Katrina Weidman investigate Eloise Psychiatric Hospital in Detroit, Mich.; once known for its cutting-edge facilities, Eloise is notorious for its aggressive spirits and is host to a dark entity that delights in choking its victims.

Katrina and Jack arrive in Petersburg, Va., to explore a bloody Civil War battlefield; they expect the echoes of forgotten voices but soon find that the intelligent spirits roaming the land desperately want to make themselves known.

Katrina Weidman and Jack Osbourne investigate the Savannah Theatre in Savannah, Ga., a paranormal playhouse dating back almost 200 years; the duo takes the stage and discovers that this theater likes to put on a horror show.

Jack and Katrina investigate a live magic venue in the bubbling resort town of Hot Springs, Ark.; in a location charged by strange geothermal forces, not all phenomena in this former movie palace appears to be the trick of a magician.
Lionel Messi has proven everything there was to prove. He then ventured to a new land and accomplished still more. His journey is truly iconic.

Amazing as it may seem, Harry Kane is still seeking his first trophy, while Zlatan Ibrahimovic has won 34 of them. ⚽ [EPL] Liverpool recorded a record-breaking series in 2020, and Wembley Stadium remains the home of football.
Sam Kerr is an emblematic figure of women's football in Australia, Mo Salah's EPL success has had a huge impact in Egypt, while the Champion's League is the supreme reward for a football club.

In the 'Urban Fit Special Guests' series, travel from Paris to London, via Johannesburg, and meet Boost (mrblockworkout). This 23-year-old former bad boy has created his own fitness training, exclusively using the urban environment.
Björn Borg and John McEnroe set new standards in men's tennis, while Mike Tyson and Evander Holyfield reached new heights in heavyweight boxing. These two rivalries created historic tensions.
Shark attacks have affected the lives of professional surfers Bethany Hamilton and Mick Fanning, whilst Kelly Slater remains the undisputed GOAT and Stephanie Gilmore astonished the world in 2022.
Captain Chiellini, as tough as they come.
Eric Cantona of ⚽ [EPL] Manchester United sees red, France's Zinedine Zidane tackles the 2006 World Cup head on, and the Uruguayan Luis Suárez takes a new mouthful in Brazil.

Michael Johnson was untouchable over 200m. Cathy Freeman's gold in 2000 brought a nation to a halt. Mo Farah achieved the double-double twice, whilst double amputee Oscar Pistorius competed in the 2012 Olympic team.

US sprinter Michael Johnson enters history in Atlanta, Ben Ainslie becomes the world's most successful medal winner as a sailor and Serena Williams delivers her most moving victory. Plus, meet the giant of the swimming pool Sun Yang and cricketer Muttiah Muralitharan.
Among the most emblematic images in sport are Usain Bolt erupting onto the Olympic scene, a Super Bowl stolen as the Butler did it, and Wayne Rooney stupefying Sir Alex Ferguson.
Pelé did not win three World Cups all by himself.

At the 1936 🏅 [Olympics] Olympic Games, Jesse Owens delivered one of the greatest sporting performances in history. At the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics, the collision between Zola Budd and Mary Decker became the talk of the Games.

p.t: Overwhelmed with IRS Debt? Keys to Resolving Tax Debt
p.d: See how one company is changing people's lives by helping them put their tax problems to rest.
Learn what's behind mental decline with age, and how to improve memory, focus and concentration with NeuroQ's Darrin Peterson and Dale Bredesen MD.

Q, Murr and Sal finally clean out their garages before giving truly spooky presentations; in the end, David Cross brings a sense of danger to the losing joker and makes a memory they're sure to remember.
Q, Murr, and Sal play mad scientists and answer for their crimes in the form of a really dumb survey; the losing joker participates in the new talk show, "Real Talk With Meth," led by Method Man.

Sal, Q and Murr show off the latest fashions for an awestruck crowd, before making a go at finding true love; ultimately, special guest Brooke Shields shows the losing joker that breaking up is hard to do.
The jokers revisit the celebrity guests they worked with throughout the season by highlighting their most memorable moments and rolling out some bonus content that has never been seen before.
Sal, Q and Murr are crashing and burning into product displays and hiding in tight spaces, but one of them must face the music with celebrity guest Bret Michaels.
The jokers give unsolicited etiquette advice and live tape strange product reviews; one lucky joker takes all the blame for celebrity guest Post Malone.
From working remotely to pitching unconventional business ideas with Steve Byrne, one Joker has a shot at winning a pair of highly sought-after sneakers thanks to NBA star Anthony Davis.
Joined by John Mayer, the Jokers must convince unsuspecting temps to accompany them to a business dinner; the losing Joker has to face the wrath of angry Mayer fans in a humiliating punishment.
Sal, Q, and Murr fall head over heels for someone they just met; a heated debate with pro wrestler MJF; a Joker discovers an untapped clairvoyant talent they possess with guest star Kesha.
A special episode hosted by Casey Jost and former NFL player Eddie Jackson as they spend time reviewing nail-biting clips of never-before-seen moments from Season 10.
Unable to pull off this week's pickleball and coffee shop challenges, the losing Jokers are forced to participate in an overseas game show hosted by special guest Paul Scheer.

The jokers are posing as salesmen and must sell their bizarre products to focus group participants, then attempt a challenge that turns out to be a mouthful; Sal finds himself in a stinky situation in tonight's punishment with guest star Kal Penn.
The jokers are dishing out as waiters and later grilled by news anchor Rosanna Scotto; finally, the losing joker is in for a horrific treat with guest star Bruce Campbell.

p.d: In Oxfordshire, agents Chris and Sam are at Blenheim Palace to try to recover a £17,000 debt owed by the 12th Duke of Marlborough.

Cops from North and West Yorkshire are cracking down on uninsured drivers whose recklessness is a cost to all of us, raising everyone's insurance premiums and killing more than 130 other road users every year.

The cops seek to protect a collection of the most vulnerable members of society including a suicidal young man with mental health problems, an Eritrean woman dumped out of a lorry by people traffickers, and a local lass who's had a barney with her two-timing boyfriend.

Ben and Matt find themselves on a high-speed pursuit which ends up on a road to nowhere, Kev and Spenner assist in a TPAC, while Carl and Wayne nearly become victims of a white-van man's dangerous driving.

Dog handler Steve rides to the aid of the armed response team after reports of a man drawing a gun on a pizza delivery driver, Charley and Wayne takeaway a drink driver at the drive thru, and Warren begins the foot pursuit to end all foot pursuits.

Sergeant Mick and the Operational Support Unit carry out a raid on a house with suspected drug activity, and uncover a cannabis farm in the loft. There is motorcycle madness as Gav apprehends a biker risking his and other road users' lives.

Patients include a young man who may have picked up an STD during a lads' holiday in Tenerife, an older man who has been chopping off a recurring growth on his scalp with a penknife, and a woman worried about a visit to hospital for a colposcopy.

28-year-old Kirsten wants to get rid of a cyst on her stomach that she thinks looks like a third nipple, while 63-year-old Julie has two lumps on her back that could be cysts or lipomas.

p.t: Canals: The Making of a Nation
p.d: This is the story of the men who built the canals, the navigators or `navvies'. They represented an `army' of hard physical men who were capable of enduring tough labour for long hours. Many roved the countryside looking for work and a better deal. They gained a reputation as troublesome outsiders, fond of drinking and living a life of ungodly debauchery. But who were they?

Paul Rose has as adrenaline overdose on his way to Coniston, beginning with entering a retro cycling event on a penny farthing before joining the mountain bikers of Grizedale Forest. Paul also relives the final moments of Donald Campbell in his attempt to break the world water-speed record on Coniston Water, and ends his trek with a spot of rock climbing at Dow Crag before the ascent of one of the areas best known hills: The Old Man of Coniston.

One of Audrey's old school friends wants to pay a visit, but she is unaware of the drop in status of the former lady of the manor. To make matters worse Podge Hodge is now slim, attractive and recently divorced.
Hyacinth volunteers Richard's services when there is a problem with the lights at the church hall, and he reluctantly agrees despite the fact that DIY is not really his forte.
Anne has grown into a real beauty. She is dazzling, and the king is caught in the glare. Her family play the long game to catch a king.

p.t: The Beginning and End of the Universe
p.d: Professor Jim Al-Khalili journeys into the distant future to try to discover how the universe will end: with a bang or a whimper? He reveals a universe far stranger than anyone imagined and, at the frontier of understanding, encounters a mysterious and enigmatic force that promises to change physics forever.
Mayuyama restores a magnificent Chinese vase bearing a mysterious inscription.

The story of how Britain's phone network was built. Incredibly, there was once a time when phones weren't pocket-sized wireless devices, but bulky objects wired into homes and workplaces. Over the course of 100 years, engineers rolled out a communications network that joined up Britain, a web of more than 70 million miles of wire.

p.t: Sound Waves: The Symphony of Physics
p.d: Dr Helen Czerski examines the extraordinary messages sound waves carry, and how they help us understand the world around us. Visiting a hidden location buried beneath the hills of Scotland, Helen experiences some of the most extreme acoustics in the world. She discovers how sound has driven the evolution of incredible biological systems and complex relationships between creatures that exploit sound for hunting.

p.t: The Hunt for the World's End Killers
p.d: On 16 October 1977, the bodies of two young women, Christine Eadie and Helen Scott, were found six miles apart in East Lothian. Both women were bound, sexually assaulted, and strangled with their own clothing. Only the night before, the two childhood friends had gone out for drinks in the World's End pub on Edinburgh's famous Royal Mile. Witnesses recalled Christine and Helen speaking with two unknown men that night.
Conversation about Scotland's biggest news stories, hosted by Martin Geissler.
Dazza and Natalie explore a lead mine and experience fine dining in Sanquhar. Despite a population of fewer than 2,000, Dazza and Natalie enjoy one of the most varied days they have ever had.
The best of Scotland's comedy, drama, documentaries, entertainment, news and sport.

A round-up of the day's news.

Steve and the team head to the remote island of Isla del Plata which has the largest congregation of giant manta rays in the world. Working with one of the world's top manta scientists, Steve heads off to try and dive with these majestic giants.

In the Gomantong cave system, Steve Backshall encounters thousands of cockroaches and one of the scariest creepy crawlies to go on the 'Deadly 60' list, the *Scutigera* centipede. Thousands of wrinkle-lipped bats call this cave their home. It is a truly awesome sight as they leave the cave in their thousands to hunt for bugs in the night sky.
Stacey Solomon and her crack team help Daniela and Tim, and their two children, to transform their family home through a life-changing declutter.

Stacey Dooley follows a squad of Ukrainian civilians from the moment they land on British soil for five weeks of gruelling training, designed to give them the skills they will need to 'survive and to be lethal' in the war against Russia.

Stacey tackles the subject of death by immersing herself in the world of undertaking. Stacey travels to Nottingham where she goes behind the scenes at AW Lymn the Family Funeral Service, a proud fifth-generation family-run business.
Author Isabel Wilkerson writes her seminal book "Caste: The Origins of Our Discontents" while coping with personal tragedy.

In a bid to raise funds for his film, Kwabena struggles to balance moonlighting as a food delivery driver. His romance with Vanessa continues to grow stronger, but Kwabena can't help but feel a little inadequate in comparison to his new girl.

At a diversity mixer, Kwabena and Amy meet Timothy Eastly, a prominent industry executive famed for producing successful films and TV shows. Kwabena lays on the charm enough to get Timothy to read his script and consider him for a writing gig.

When Funmi goes into labour, a nervous Maurice is more on edge than ever. Doctors at the hospital refuse to take Funmi's concerns seriously, and her life may well soon hang in the balance. With everything going on, Kwabena reconsiders his priorities.

After the birth of baby Mayowa, Kwabena moves back home with his mother. He struggles to impress the jurors in his development scheme and must decide whether he is willing to do what needs to be done to get the funding.

Kwabena is riding high after showcasing his film, which has gone down brilliantly with old friends and important guests from the film industry, and he finally receives an offer that makes him feel like he has taken the first step towards his dream.
A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
The game show that mixes general knowledge quizzing and bowling.
Engaging conversation about the political issues that matter to you.

Bats have colonised remote corners of the planet to become one of the most widespread mammals on earth. Chris Packham explores their incredible anatomy, physiology and senses to understand what enables them to thrive in some surprising places.

Looking at the remote South Pacific islands. Their extraordinary isolation has created some of the most curious, surprising and precarious examples of life found anywhere on Earth, from giant crabs that tear open coconuts to flesh-eating caterpillars that impale their prey on dagger-like claws. Human culture is different, too.

Paul Martin presents from the Grand Pier at Weston-super-Mare in Somerset, where experts Catherine Southon and Jonathan Pratt pick out some gems to value. Among them are rare medals that once belonged to an early aviator and puppets that look like the Swedish band ABBA. Plus, Paul delves into the history of seaside entertainment.

Jennie Bond, James Bye, Kadeena Cox and Aurie Styla take on a series of quiz rounds selected by quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week.

For 11 months of the year, the city of La Vega is well off the tourist track. But each February, it bursts into life. Over the course of four weekends, it's loud, hot and colourful as visitors from all over the world arrive to join in the famous street carnivals.

Paul visits Wester Ross and discovers the heritage of Little Loch Broom. He then travels to the off-grid community of Scoraig where he learns about violin making and wind power, before taking the plunge to explore the hidden depths of the Corrieshalloch Gorge.
Three teams, one beach, six hours to build the ultimate sandcastle. Who will sculpt to glory before the tide washes it all away in the grand final?
In Watergate Bay, one of Cornwall's surfing hotspots, two teenage boys are caught in one of the beach's notorious rip currents.
Kye's abscess hasn't responded to treatment, and it's possible the 26-year-old's drug use has caused complications. 88-year-old Lady Carole needs surgery to retain her mobility.

Ash is hopeful that romance will rekindle when Gordon invites her on a weekend road trip, until she discovers that Brett and Chiara are joining them. When Chiara suggests they do a '90s thing and lock away their phones, things go downhill fast.

Ancient Aliens explores the controversial theory that extra-terrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years.
Nazi scientists develop advanced weapons, including Die Glocke, believed to have been a time-travel device.

Lana tries to impress her mum at a magic school but learns to embrace her unique talents after chaos ensues. Reality shifts with every roll of a magical dice. Lana must outwit its Titan creators to restore order.
Gigi accidentally becomes the Juggling Club President, much to Sully's dismay.

Mordecai, a blue jay, and Rigby, a raccoon, are groundskeepers at a park. They are best friends, but are lazy and don't let their jobs interfere with their ability to have fun. Their laziness puts them in constant conflict with their boss.

The kids find out Dad has been dressing as a woman. A compilation of some of the funniest, most bizarre clips uploaded onto the internet by the people of Elmore. Rob creates a variety of spinoff Elmore shows and formats in order to replace Gumball.
Bytz plays Battle Royale while Wanda About hunts aliens. Mech-Max and Wanda About go from gorilla doctors and fire-fighting parrots to a prison escape with robot guards.
When drinking tea turns the other Titans English, it's up to Robin to save America from another British invasion. The Titans become hackers to stop a gang of computer pirates.
Mordecai and Rigby track down a legendary, top-secret meal. Their simple quest quickly escalates into chaos as they face absurd culinary challenges to order the ultimate secret menu item.

Pieces of Mr Reese's past are revealed when his old partner on the police force, Officer Moody, visits Aberdale Elementary. Gilben's newly sprouted peach fuzz sparks a discussion about puberty that convinces Clarence to act more like an adult.
The children complain so much they become charity cases; The Wattersons are running for their lives.
The Titans throw a slumber party to help Cyborg get over his fear of Scary Teri. / A road trip in Cyborg's T-Car is really fun - for a while.
Marceline shows up and she wants the tree fort back. Finn and Jake enter a City of Thieves.
Mordecai completely panics after running into the child he used to babysit.

p.t: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
p.d: Anais's science project creates a genius version of Richard's gut, forcing her to choose between it and her real dad. Anais starts ageing prematurely due to the stress and pressure of looking out for the rest of her stupid family.
Rapping science teacher Matt Green becomes the first human being ever to visit Quark as he joins Pipette on her home planet to help host this special episode about Earth and space.

The Doctors meet Larry the vomiting robot to show the power of puke and Dr Xand goes on an emergency mission on a motorbike to deliver blood to a hospital urgently. Meanwhile, over in accident and emergency one patient has fallen off his bike and another has a football injury.
The Kwapongs craft fire-breathers, Romesh Ranganathan draws a rapping T. rex, and Bristles dives into the bold, brilliant world of Frida Kahlo.

Southern Africa is a riot of life and colour because of two great ocean currents that sweep around the continent's Cape. To the east, the warm Agulhas current generates clouds that roll inland to the wettest place in Southern Africa. To the west is the cold Benguela current, home to more great white sharks than anywhere else. Moisture laden fog rolls inland, supporting an incredible desert garden.
Guided by pro-gamer Slogo, the teams serve up an epic game of 'Switch Sports 🎾 [Tennis] Tennis'.
Andy has double-booked himself and must attend a family party rather than the band's anniversary celebrations. Moxy plans a daring mission to break him out.
The Fantastics have come as their heroes for Hero Day. Sophie doesn't know who to choose.
While rescuing river creatures after a storm, the Octonauts find a strange egg and come under attack by stinging platypuses.
Big Lizard and Cosima undertake an exciting night-time mission rehoming a friendly slug that has taken residence in Cosima's bedroom!
The shadow of a monster causes panic among the Piris, apart from Nugget, who is keen to investigate a new mystery. She finally tracks down the creature, but is all exactly as it seems?
When Duck is selling ice cream on the beach from his ice cream van, Frog really wants to find the prize-winning golden lolly stick, and will go to any lengths to get it!
Duck is working on the check-in desk at an airport and won't allow Frog to check in his enormous suitcase. Will Frog be able to slim it down and catch his plane?
Priding herself on being the only flying hero, Twinkle is upset by Herbert's flying invention, and the pair risk a quest by being too competitive.
The Lemmings set up a mini fair, but Grizzy steals the Lemmings' tickets.
Strictly stars Katya and Rhys go head-to-head in a boys v girls dance battle.

Life-changing sums of money can be won, but only if someone manages to beat The Beast, The Governess, The Sinnerman, The Vixen and The Dark Destroyer. Bradley Walsh hosts.
Jon, Terence, Fil and Lucy take on the Chaser in the hope of winning thousands of pounds.

p.d: Henry Cole, Simon O'Brien and Max McMurdo travel across the UK to find unique items lost in people's homes to fix up for a profit. This episode features an Austrian moped.

Connor and Lia renovate a huge, three-storey house in Newport, south Wales. It's a much-loved family home but needs major updating throughout, and concerns about falling behind schedule start to cause tension.

In the heart of Boston, Violet and her best friend Pati host at Violet's three ultra-modern self-catering flats, Escape Town, where the so-called 'smart loos' perhaps aren't that clever.

The second host, plumber and adult merchandise director Richard, is cooking a rich and indulgent menu and making everything from scratch. But will undergarment unearthing and a decadent dessert be too much for some?

After a meek city safety inspector survives being poisoned, he tries to help Castle and Beckett with the investigation.

p.t: The Big Steam Adventure: Here We Go Again!
p.d: Peter Davison, John Sergeant and Paul Middleton meet in historic Greenwich to begin their adventure. Their first vehicle is the Challenge, a Thames steam tug that took part in the evacuation of troops from Dunkirk in 1940.

Near the end of a bank holiday weekend, Biker Cop Paul Buckley is called to a serious crash involving a car and motorbike in the North Yorkshire countryside. Being a biker, Paul can often cover the county's 3000 miles of road faster than other units.
On the M6, PC Elly Martin helps stop a cloned Audi after police box it in busy traffic, then stops a white van driver who, it transpires, has an overstayed visa and seven points on his licence.
Robert receives a visitor who warns him to keep his mouth shut about what happened 20 years ago. Dan arrives at a chaotic fundraiser, ready to make an arrest for murder.

Offers the most revealing television account yet of the Raoul Moat case. It features previously unheard material from Moat's Dictaphone recordings, which offer an unsettling insight into his mindset during the rampage.

Lois will, dass sich ihre älteren Söhne einen Job suchen. Reese ergattert eine lukrative Stelle als Metzger. Malcolm hingegen muss sich mit einer schlecht bezahlten Anstellung im Supermarkt zufriedengeben, bei dem auch Lois arbeitet.

Es ist Weihnachtszeit und Hal verliert für ein paar Wochen seinen Job. Er hat die Idee, mit dem Verkauf von Weihnachtsbäumen Geld für das Weihnachtsfest zu verdienen. Als die Jungs ihm anbieten mitzumachen, geht für Hal ein Traum in Erfüllung.

In einer Therapiesitzung stellt sich Thor seinen alten Wunden aus der Vergangenheit. Währenddessen versucht Jays Schwester Bela, im neu eröffneten Restaurant des Hauses auszuhelfen. Doch ihre gut gemeinte Unterstützung sorgt nur für noch mehr Chaos.
Bastian ist verzweifelt - er wartet schon seit Tagen auf eine DVD-Box. Als er nach einem Tag voller Warten den Briefkasten prüft, findet er dort eine Benachrichtigung von DHL vor.
Michael Kosta empfängt die Journalistin und 🎾 [Tennis] Tennis-Expertin Giri Nathan zu Gast im Studio.

Francine ist vom ewigen Streit zwischen Hayley und Stan so genervt, dass sie die beiden dazu zwingt, einen kompletten Tag miteinander zu verbringen. Ihr Plan, Stan und Hayley dadurch zu versöhnen, geht aber gründlich schief, weil Stan seine Tochter zu einem Treffen der "National Gun Association Land" mitnimmt. Hier eskalieren die Meinungsverschiedenheiten massiv! Unterdessen rächt sich Roger an Steve dafür, dass der einen seiner Kekse gegessen hat, indem er ihm weiß macht, dass er adoptiert ist.

Überraschend für alle wird Steve plötzlich ein erfolgreicher Schriftsteller und berühmt. Die Familie kann sich gegen den neuen Ansturm der Popularität nicht wehren. Außerdem scheint Steve der Erfolg immer mehr zu Kopf zu steigen.

Die Mitglieder der Planet-Express-Crew verdächtigen sich alle gegenseitig, ein Dieb zu sein. Professor Farnsworth will nicht mehr tatenlos zusehen und organisiert einen Teamausflug. Doch auch dabei geschehen mysteriöse Dinge.

Dr. Zoidberg trifft seine große Liebe: eine Frau, die ohne Geruchssinn geboren wurde. Zoidberg könnte sie durch eine Operation heilen, doch das würde sein Glück gefährden. Dann würde sie vor seinem Gestank fliehen, wie alle anderen auch.

Gene und Courtney sollen die morgendliche Ankündigung übernehmen, allerdings steht ihnen ihre gemeinsame romantische Vergangenheit gehörig im Weg. Tina fühlt sich unterdessen als Liebesbotin berufen - und scheitert kläglich.

Dottie Minerva steckt sich mit dem Pfeifferschen Drüsenfieber an, weshalb Tina Solistin bei den Harmoniums wird. Doch als dann die Proben für die große Versammlung anstehen, wird Tina klar, dass ihre Rolle in dem Stück ihr schaden könnte.

Bobs Freund Warren bietet an, in Bobs Restaurant zu investieren und es zu renovieren. Bob freut sich über die guten Nachrichten und die Chance auf eine Generalüberholung - bis er Warrens Pläne sieht. Dieser will das Restaurant komplett verändern.
Mit Fackeln und Südstaatenflaggen ausgestattete Demonstranten strömen durch die Straßen von South Park. Randy begreift, was es in der heutigen Gesellschaft für eine Bedeutung hat, weiß zu sein.

Am Kolumbus-Tag verhält sich Randy ziemlich daneben und sorgt für reichlich Verwirrung. Er zerstört unter anderem eine Statue des berühmten Entdeckers und missbraucht das Wort "einheimisch". Die Kinder fragen sich, was da wohl los ist.

Die Smiths leben weiter in Saudi-Arabien. Stan genießt die patriarchalische Gesellschaftsform, während der Rest der Familie sich schwertut. Francines gesellschaftskritisches Musical bringt sie letztendlich in Schwierigkeiten.
When Ray loses his ring he is propositioned by an attractive woman at the airport. When Debra learns what happened, she pretends to be single, but her plan has disastrous results.
After hurting themselves during a tryst, Ray and Debra say they fell down the stairs. During home repairs, Frank gets hurt causing Ray and Debra to feel guilty about their lie.
Debra and Marie's good intentions backfire badly when they try to drive Robert back into Amy's arms, and find that Amy and Gianni are actually hitting it off.

While the Barones watch their sons play, Ray finds that Geoff is having trouble getting the hang of the game, but then learns the hard way that his son's lack of ability shouldn't interfere with either of them enjoying the game.
Josh and Harvey are fighting for Sabrina's affection, so she feeds them magic friendship bread to bring peace, but they become too close and start to ignore her.
After spending the summer trying to get over her first love, Sabrina decides to make some big changes in her life.
In order to keep up with the overwhelming academic and social demands of college life, Sabrina puts herself under a complicated time spell to move at lightning speed.
Sabrina (Melissa Joan Hart) throws a Halloween bash that turns into the year's biggest party. Guests star: Tisha Campbell.

Monica's first Thanksgiving dinner for the gang goes horribly wrong when they all get locked on the roof after watching a giant runaway balloon from the New York Thanksgiving parade. Elsewhere, Joey wins his first modelling gig as the poster boy for a venereal disease campaign, and Ross competes with his ex-wife to communicate with their unborn baby.

As New Year approaches, the gang make a pact to celebrate at Monica and Rachel's flat without bringing any dates. However, as the New Year gets closer, all of them find themselves breaking that promise except for Ross, who brings along his new pet monkey Marcel.
Chandler's flamboyant mother visits New York, while Phoebe and Monica flirt with a handsome stranger while crossing a road and end up causing a traffic accident.
Rachel's Italian boyfriend tries to seduce Phoebe, Rachel accidentally reveals a secret to Ross, and Monica's aunt refuses to take the lasagnes she ordered.
Chandler accidentally sees Rachel wandering around topless after her shower, so Rachel tries to even the score.

It's Valentine's Day and, out on his first date in nine years, Ross meets up with his ex-wife. Meanwhile, Monica, Phoebe and Rachel rebel against the spirit of the day by burning mementos of past relationships.
The owner of a fancy restaurant where Monica applies for the chef's position is a little high on illicit substances when he tries the gourmet feast she prepares for him.
Mike sets Stacy up with a timid city councilman, and they are both surprised when she falls for him.
Stuart and Carter become acquainted with an older gay couple who have recently moved into their building. Meanwhile, Mike finds himself in a battle of wits with Bobo, an intelligent chimpanzee.
Rachel and Ross can't figure out if they are legally married. Monica and Chandler search for matrimonial signs.

Joey is upset to learn that Chandler plans to move out to live with Monica, but Rachel seems strangely unaffected by the news. Phoebe pleads with Ross to either get an annulment or admit that he still loves Rachel.
Monica and Chandler disagree over how to redecorate Rachel's old room and despite Phoebe's admonitions, Ross makes a drastic decision about Rachel.
After learning that his health insurance has lapsed because he has not worked enough as an actor, Joey suffers a painful hernia, and Rachel finally finds out that Ross never annulled their marriage.
Featuring motoring misdemeanours, citizens arrests and delinquent animals.
Criminal capers including bad getaways, raccoons in a freezer, and OAPs out for justice.
The guys conduct interviews for DNA testing and cause mischief at the grocery store while wearing bath robes. Also, the big loser cracks under pressure during a presentation at a children's museum.
The guys must do and say what they are told to while working at the Universal Orlando location of 'Fast & Furious: Supercharged', where every single refusal counts as a thumbs down.

Frank is so envious that he forces Marco to choose either Marie or him as a friend, and Ray sides with Frank because he doesn't approve of a married woman, especially his mother, having a male friend.
