A super fan takes an unwelcome swim at a celebrity's house; a man goes wild at the gym and on the streets of Miami - totally naked; bank robbers attract a crowd when they throw stolen cash out their car window, and more.
A convicted triple murderer battles with the judge during sentencing; a shirtless defendant fires his lawyer; a sleepy jailbird calls the judge her best friend.
Glyn Dix served time behind bars for the brutal killing of his landlady, only to strike again upon his release, this time by murdering his wife after an argument.
The story of 17-year-old Shafilea, who was cruelly killed by her own parents in 2003 because they thought she had become too Westernised.
The chilling story of a man who killed his pregnant ex-wife in a jealous frenzy with a crossbow that narrowly avoided the head of her unborn child.
When an experienced outdoorsman is found viciously stabbed to death on a hunting trip, investigators work tirelessly to eventually uncover the stunning truth.
New Year's Eve 2012 should have been the biggest party of the year for fun-loving Mike Pimentel and his girlfriend. So how did he end up dead on the street shortly after midnight?
When 34-year-old John Maier vanishes, rumours swirl. Detective Larry Woebbeking uses unorthodox tactics to win over a key witness and uncover the truth.
A fun-loving bachelor, Walter Zucchetti, is found dead in his flat, his mouth sealed with red tape, leaving people to wonder who could have harmed such a nice man.
Layne Schmidtke is beaten to death by a group of teenagers.
When someone kills a young man at a party in a Gwinnett County park, detectives must turn to the families of the victim and possible suspect to break the silence.
When an experienced outdoorsman is found viciously stabbed to death on a hunting trip, investigators work tirelessly to eventually uncover the stunning truth.
Investigators search for Sabina Nessa, who goes missing after walking to meet a friend on a Friday night.

After a massive storm hits Warwick Cove, Rhode Island, a boat dragging its anchor appears in the harbour with a badly decomposed corpse onboard; pathologist Dr. Priya Banerjee must identify the John Doe and determine how he died.
Tyler Kerry travelled to Turkey with his family to make memories. Days later, he vanished from their hotel. When his body is found, questions remain over what happened.

Customs officers fish some hash bales out of the sea which have been dropped by drug dealers and incinerate them. Discarded smugglers' jerry cans wash up on a beach, and cops stop a car laden with extra fuel.
Driving the old camper van, Rick Stein heads east from the Basque Country on his way towards Spain's Mediterranean coast. Along the way, he samples a range of great Spanish dishes.
Rick attends a beach party in La Palosa where everyone gets stuck into lunch. He then visits the Costa Brava for the best seafood in the country.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy set out to find interesting old cars for new drivers, then put them to the test on a road trip through Devon and Cornwall. Chris drives the original supercar, Lamborghini's legendary Miura.
Freddie, Chris and Paddy saddle up the team bus for an RV road trip across Florida's swampy Everglades. Their mission is to hunt down some weird and wonderful local motorsports.

Paul, Bob and trusty terrier Ted travel to Blakeney Point in North Norfolk for a sea fishing adventure. After a day of mixed fortunes, they take a boat back to the car and head to their accommodation, Bear's Cottage for the night to dry out.

p.t: James May's Cars of the People
p.d: James travels to Germany, Italy and Russia to investigate mass-produced cars that were made under dictatorships. In the process, he explores the Trabant, Fiat 124 and Volkswagen Beetle.
Convenience food serves a purpose, but if you want something truly delicious, it's worth searching out the best ingredients and cooking them to perfection, however long it may take.

Rick attends a beach party in La Palosa where everyone gets stuck into lunch. He then visits the Costa Brava for the best seafood in the country.

Paul and Bob head to the River Ouse in the heart of Bedfordshire. The river was once famous for barbel, but has recently become renowned for its big perch instead, a fish that has so far eluded them. Bob makes Paul a dinner he will never forget.

Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return for an episode of previously unseen material from the hit comedy panel show. Among the guests joining Lee and David are Clare Balding, Liz Bonnin, Jo Brand, Asim Chaudhry, and more.

Rob Brydon is back in the host's chair for a very special Christmas episode of the award-winning comedy panel show. Guests Jo Brand, Joe Swash, Joe Lycett and Ruth Madeley join Lee Mack and David Mitchell to sort the festive facts from the fibs.

p.d: Mel Giedroyc is guest host, with panellists comedian Chris McCausland and broadcaster Kirsty Wark joining team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop as they delve into the news.

p.d: Richard Ayoade hosts with panellists rail union leader Mick Lynch and comedian Roisin Conaty joining team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop as they delve into the news.
Stretched thin and desperately off-pace, Jared watches a loader tumble down the road; foreman Brad attempts to land his plane in choppy weather but is forced to shelter nearby; Barge Day arrives.

Builder Phil Parr heads to the wilderness of northern Colorado to build the ultimate off-grid tent; far beyond simple nylon and poles, this lavish tent has a custom fabricated wooden frame, canvas shell and 650-square-feet of liveable elegance.
A modern, solar-powered home with a wood-burning fireplace, gourmet kitchen and 400-square-foot loft is built in the stunning Black Hills of South Dakota.
The staff develop an innovative course of treatment when a cheetah has an injury; the zoo hosts the only pair of platypuses outside Australia.

The Rhino Rescue Centre welcomes Arthur, the southern white rhino calf; a young nyala must be hand-raised before returning to its herd; koala joeys make a big move; Connor the Malaysian tiger struggles with strange nosebleeds.
Arizona natives, Kendra and Eric, are relocating from Phoenix to the tundra of Delta Junction, Alaska. Will they be able to find a place they can call home?
The Mat-Su Valley has the rivers and lakes Thane and Rose dream of. Having moved from Guam to Alaska, this unlikely couple lives off the land.
There aren't any palm trees or tropical ocean breezes in the 49th state, but you can still live a beach lifestyle on one of Alaska's three million lakes.
Tim and Natalie are renting a property on the Kenai River, but have always dreamed of a challenging lifestyle in a home on one of the river's few islands.

Marty returns to Interior Alaska to help a single mother whose homestead is on the brink of ruin. With a quake-damaged water line and bears circling the property, he must act fast to protect the Adams family's animals and dream.
Mike finds a rare beast, a 1976 Mercury Capri MK2 with the classic 2.8 litre V6. However, it's not without its problems which means a lot of work for Ant.
The pinnacle of BMW is the modern classic, the E46 M3. Mike finds one with the subframe already fixed, and he challenges Ant to transform the transmission with new tech.
On the Time Bandit, Johnathan delegates dentistry duties when his brother Neal's dental implants fail far out to sea. Battling 25-foot waves, Keith leans heavily on his co-captain Monte.

p.d: Groundbreaking storytelling techniques reveal the high-stakes drama that unfolds at the epicentre of recent natural disasters, as told through firsthand accounts and mobile phone footage filmed by everyday people caught in the eye of the storm.

The Valley of the Queens is a vast necropolis concealing some of Egypt's most miraculous tombs and powerful women; now, investigators use cutting-edge tech to explore lost tunnels and uncover the enigmatic secrets behind these ancient pharaohs.
In Suffolk, Drew spots an architectural wreath that is over 100 years old.
In Fulham, Drew prepares to spend big with some elite dealers. In Hastings, Drew and Tee unearth some unusual Chinese watercolours and a Turkish rug.
Scientists have discovered evidence of a mysterious ninth planet on the very edge of our solar system, could its moons support extra-terrestrial life?
A series of recent UFO sightings brings Chuck Zukowski's team to Missouri, the home of the 1973 Piedmont lights incident. Armed with new evidence, they tackle whether history is repeating itself.

Josh scours Virginia backcountry in search of the legendary Thomas Beale Treasure, worth millions today. With encrypted codes hiding its whereabouts, Josh takes a detour to Philadelphia to uncover missing pieces to the puzzle.

Jess and Phil head to England in search of a legendary monstrous beast that's said to stalk the wilderness. After an unforgettable and truly historic encounter, they realise the creature is more than a myth.
Don Wildman examines a replica of America's most famous bell, inspects a photograph of a suspicious-looking chef and investigates an illustrated book depicting a devilish fiend.
Don Wildman explores a woman's quest for athletic glory, uncovers a bizarre use of the US Postal Service and investigates one man's will to survive against all odds.
NASA's Juno probe is unlocking Jupiter's secrets, answering mysteries and gathering data. Scientists and experts explain the importance of this mission.
Lockheed were tasked with creating a plane invisible to Russian radar, capable of reaching an altitude of 80,000 ft and speeds of Mach 3.2.
An archaeological excavation uncovers ancient human carnage; experts use 3D modelling to reveal what may be the first major war in human history.

How do they set up a 1700 seat circus tent in just 36 hours? How do they turn Japanese maple and mahogany into the coolest instrument on earth - the electric guitar?
Bruce is on a WWI treasure hunt, finding a mysterious soldier's medal from the Battle of the Somme. Plus, he finds the world's most expensive football.

p.t: James May's Shed Load Of Ideas
p.d: James tackles incorrectly issued parking tickets in his Wiltshire workshop. The team also try to improve the efficiency of chopping chips for James' pub and attempt to get local Roger's antique wind-up boat back on the water.

Things appear to be on the up when they land a prestigious Morgan job, but a disastrous E-Type re-build prompts an emergency audit by Richard's mum. The verdict is damning.
Mike buys a supercar from the super saver menu, specifically an Italian thoroughbred for under £10,000, but with supercars come super-sized bills.
Henry and Sam go to Hull to meet Mandy, whose late husband was an avid collector of classic motorbikes. There are several rare Vincents and Ariels on offer.
Henry and Fuzz are in West Sussex at Dino's mega-shed. He's got buses, vintage sports cars, rare motorbikes and oodles of motoring ephemera.
With the workshop haemorrhaging money, Richard brings in heavyweight help. And attempts to make money through selling merchandise backfire when Lewis massively over-orders stock.

Ein Familienvater aus London hat es versäumt, genug Geld für eine neue Wohnung anzusparen und muss aus seiner alten Unterkunft ausziehen. Die Gerichtsvollzieher Paul Bohill und Max Carracher müssen eine Zwangsräumung durchführen.

Ein Mann aus London hat es versäumt, 21.762 Pfund zu bezahlen und die Gerichtsvollzieher Steve Pinner und Max Carracher vermuten, dass seine Frau ihn in ihrem Haus versteckt. Sie befestigen folglich eine Parkkralle an dem Wagen der Familie.

Greg zieht mit einem schweren Bagger seine Waschanlage auf Mats Land. Die Männer haben einen Deal ausgehandelt und werden bei der Schatzsuche ein Team bilden. Den Gewinn, den sie zusammen schürfen, wollen sie sich in Down Under teilen.

Matthias Maurer stattet den Schatzsuchern am Palmer River im Norden von Queensland einen Überraschungsbesuch ab. Dort zeigt Andreas dem ESA-Astronauten, mit welchen Geräten die Männer im australischen Busch den Edelmetallanteil im Boden untersuchen.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Das Ende der Saison ist in Sicht. Monte Colburn, der Kapitän der "Wizard", hat seine Fangnetze versehentlich in einem Gebiet ausgebracht, in dem wegen Artenschutz-Bestimmungen nicht gefischt werden darf. Nun muss er mit einer heftigen Strafe rechnen.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Die "Arctic Hunter" sendet einen Notruf; sie ist auf Grund gelaufen und droht zu sinken. Die "Saga" befindet sich zufällig in der Nähe, und Kapitän Elliott Neese eilt den Schiffbrüchigen gemeinsam mit seiner Crew zu Hilfe.

p.t: Border Control: Türkei - Grenzschützer im Einsatz
p.d: Ein Transitcontainer aus Serbien mit Zielhafen in Russland trifft in Istanbul im Zollbereich ein. Laut Anmeldung enthält er Calciumcarbonat. Doch möglicherweise befinden sich darin illegale Stoffe. Daher werden die Säcke stichprobenartig geprüft.

Am Stockholmer Flughafen ist bei Passagieren diesmal ein Bußgeld fällig. In Nyköping kommen im Gepäck einer Reisenden aus Albanien, die in Schweden angeblich eine Freundin besuchen will, verdächtige Substanzen zum Vorschein.

Stiefvater und Stiefsohn haben eine Uhr geerbt und möchten von Daniela Löschner in Bochum wissen, was das Objekt wert ist. In Karlsruhe werden Jabez Frisch mehrere Schatullen mit Gold-, Silber- und Modeschmuck angeboten.
Große Lagerflächen und schnelle Entscheidungen: Florian und Jabez lernen das Pfandleihgeschäft in den USA kennen. Gleich der erste Kunde bringt einen Pick-up voller Ware ins Paramount Pawn.

In Bad Bramstedt soll eine turnusmäßige Dachrinnenreinigung schnell und unkompliziert über die Bühne gehen. Das ist für Lucas und Nicolai ein Routineauftrag. Doch wie so oft im Leben verläuft die Angelegenheit anders als geplant.

Während die Hausmeister in Kempen auf einem engen Stadtgrundstück drei große Bäume fällen müssen, fällt in Schleswig-Holstein in einer Lagerhalle die Videoüberwachung aus. Zudem ist in München diesmal besonderes Feingefühl gefragt.

Für Hausmeister Ralf beginnt der Tag in München mit einer belastenden Aufgabe. In der bayerischen Landeshauptstadt soll die vermüllte Wohnung eines Verstorbenen entrümpelt werden. Darin befindet sich jede Menge Unrat.

Die Sendung informiert über alle wichtigen Neuigkeiten aus der Welt. Die Zuschauer bekommen so einen Überblick über den aktuellen Stand verschiedenster Themen wie Gesellschaft, Kultur, Politik, Sport, Wirtschaft und Zeitgeschehen.

Ralf kämpft mit seinem Team auf einem verlassenen Grundstück in München gegen wucherndes Grün an. Die Folgen von ausuferndem Wildwuchs lassen sich am Haus nebenan beobachten. In Köln sind die Hausmeister ebenfalls um Schadensbegrenzung bemüht.
These builders are dreaming big while still living in harmony with Mother Nature, from a Colorado solar abode to a Texas earth block ranch.
For some off-grid builders, there's nothing better than living at sea level, but others prefer the air a little thinner; from a snowy North Pole abode to a Colorado Rockies retreat.

Sig returns from his mother's funeral only to find his gear in harm's way. Rick and Keith forge a beneficial partnership. Jack makes his first offload as captain. The Coast Guard gets a call to extract a sailor with broken legs 200 miles out to sea.
The team tracks down a unique marker, taking them to a maze-like location riddled with caves. The determination pays off as they start unearthing priceless artefacts.

Josh explores ancient shrines hidden in the mountains and underground tunnels across Japan in search of the missing mystical Honjo sword. He also learns the ways of the samurai and forges his own samurai sword.

Josh joins local divers in the Southeast Asian country of Myanmar to search for the ancient cursed Golden Bell of King Dhammazedi. To recover it, Josh dives into murky, violent waters that have claimed the lives of other divers.

The Raneys face an emotional rescue of young, inexperienced homesteaders in Alabama. To save the legacy of an 8th generation family property, they must use all new ingenuity including a solar kiln, tornado bunker and upcycled predator-proof coop.
On the eve of the famous Lightning Ridge Opal Festival, The Misfits battle to treat 150kg of matrix opal, forcing Cody to cook up a miracle.
Oscar sends The Cheals on an important mission to unearth a rare green-orange gemstone for a potential buyer. The Mooka Boys get a motor problem.
Jacqui and Andrew feel the pressure as they battle hard rock ground that could potentially ruin their latest deal. Plus, Shane and Russell join forces to go on a hunt for an ancient mine.
The Poseidon Crew are running out of time to find a 1,000-ounce nugget. The Gold Retrievers end up working all through the night in an attempt to escape the dangerous heat of the summer.
Robbie transports a huge house amidst a tropical storm. Plus, Sludge's wife, Wendy, takes the wheel following his motorcycle accident.

Alan and Salty head to wine country to chase a gold rush legend, a drought threatens to end the season for Shane and Kate, and the Poseidon Crew use an over-sized metal detector to get some seriously oversized nuggets.
Heather and Phil head to Tennessee's Brushy Mountain Penitentiary to investigate terrifying reports of possession and confront the violent, powerful, and hostile forces lurking in its remains.
A vet and a military mum tackle the harsh conditions of Mexico's Cayo Venado with a week of freezing rain for the survivalists.

Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

A pirate Viking beguiles his men with the story of `The Mother of Voices', a huge bell made of solid gold, but his stories reach Aly Mansuh, the leader of an army of Moors, who capture Rolfe and his crew. Mansuh and Rolfe form an uneasy alliance as they set off in search of the treasure.
Young Charlie is thrilled when her favourite uncle arrives for a visit, but soon begins to suspect that he could be the notorious 'Merry Widow Murderer'.

p.t: The Theory of Everything: Interview Special
p.d: Stars Eddie Redmayne and Felicity Jones and director James Marsh talk about making the moving romantic drama about the relationship between Stephen and Jane Hawking.

Robert Jordan is the idealist who joins the Republicans and is charged with blowing up a strategically important bridge. Among the group aiding him are Maria, with whom he falls in love, Pablo, the drunken leader of the group, and his wife Pilar, who eventually takes charge.

A young Brooklyn couple head to an upstate cabin to unplug from their phones and reconnect with each other. Blissfully unaware of their surroundings, they are left to their own devices as the planet falls under attack.

On the brink of losing her childhood home, a desperate woman agrees to date a wealthy couple's introverted and awkward 19-year-old son. However, he proves to be more of a challenge than she expected, and time is running out before she loses it all.
A would-be thief is remanded to the custody of her estranged mother, who turns out to be correct in her assertion that evil spirits are afoot in their family domicile.

The illegitimate son of an African slave and a French plantation owner, Joseph Bologne rises to improbable heights in French society as a celebrated violinist-composer and fencer, complete with a love affair and falling out with Marie Antoinette.

Shahzer, a wealthy heir with a dominating personality and short temper, crosses paths with Shifa, a responsible woman engaged to his close friend Maaz. His unexpected feelings for her spark conflict between love, friendship and loyalty.

p.d: Exploring how John F. Kennedy's worldview was influenced by his younger years, when he suffered from health conditions, a family tragedy involving his sister, and a demanding father.

Carrie goes undercover with a team of bank robbers to pursue a lead on the gang's notorious and elusive leader.

When a bridge collapse results in many deaths, the victims' families come after the engineer who designed it, but once he is in witness protection, he attempts to clear his name, regardless of the consequences.
A desperate young murder suspect, Emma Briggs, takes hostages at gunpoint then mysteriously insists that she will only negotiate with one person: Richard Castle.
Dr Mark Sloan investigates the apparent suicide of a gifted heart surgeon who was also a compulsive gambler.
Mark takes on the extortionists responsible for murdering the twin sister of a young woman who claims Dr Travis fathered her infant son.
When a stuntman dies in a routine car stunt during the filming of one of Jessica's novels, the writer suspects foul play.
Jessica is incredulous when private investigator Charlie Garrett bids $400,000 for a mediocre painting at an exclusive New York auction house - until the artist is murdered.
A grisly murder investigation leads Castle and Beckett to a suspect who claims he's travelled back in time to stop terrible events from unfolding.
As Carrie and Al investigate the murder of a businessman, they realize his death was collateral damage in an assassination plot.

Ex-con Dennis joins witness protection, but a series of murders seems to follow him - as well as the stabbing of a friend of Mary's. As the killings mount up, Mary and Marshall must figure out whether Dennis is responsible in time to save the next victim.
After a shocking murder at his friend's restaurant, food consultant Henry and detective Maggie must work together to investigate the city's top chefs.

p.t: Murder Under the Friday Night Lights
p.d: In 1985, police find the body of a beloved coach in the barrens of southeast Texas, triggering a murder investigation laced with sex, jealousy and revenge. Investigators close in on the killer, but an eleventh-hour twist tears the community apart.

p.t: Murder Under the Friday Night Lights
p.d: The Hill family lives in a gated community near Dawson HS, where their daughter Arrijana is a popular athlete. When she is found murdered in her bedroom, detectives learn that Arrijana was hiding a secret that leads them to her killer.

p.t: On the Case With Paula Zahn
p.d: The chilling murder of Lee Rotatori and the bizarre crime scene evidence police found inside her motel room mark the beginning of a heartbreaking homicide investigation with multiple victims.

p.t: Evil Lives Here: Shadows of Death
p.d: In 2021, when 33-year-old Erika Verdecia goes missing, her family launches their own search for her. What their homegrown investigation uncovers is a tragic trail of bloodshed, 36 years in the making.

p.t: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks
p.d: Josh Clark takes what he wants. His family loves and supports him, but he's intent on destroying them. No one sacrifices more for him than his grandmother, yet she's the one who suffers his wrath. Now, his mum and brother want him to tell them why.

Amanda Perrault's dream move to a lake house with her husband and his young daughter turns into a nightmare. A campaign of abuse and terrifying home invasions lead to murder, and a Sheriff must outwit a calculating killer to bring justice.
When Mandy meets Paul online, he quickly moves to Kentucky so they can marry. But love soon turns to hate when his controlling behaviour turns murderous.

Jessica Jaramillo escaped her abusive ex-husband Chad Graves, but a joint custody agreement for her children means he will always be in their lives. His increasingly obsessive behaviour reveals he is not who he presents himself to be.

Police officer Andy Kimbrel hopes to find happiness with new wife Stephanie Keller, but when the marriage starts to fail, Andy falls victim to manipulation and violence; a fierce argument leads to tragedy, and police suspect something more.

When the relationship between mothers and their children becomes a breeding ground for conspiracy, manipulation and murder, this toxic bond leaves a trail of misery and destruction throughout America.

Terrifying true stories of mothers and their children when nature's strongest bond morphs into conspiracy, manipulation and murder. Acts of greed, revenge and cruelty leave trails of torment and destruction across America.
A mother-of-two vanishes from her home in Utah in 2009. As police investigate, dark family secrets emerge, and a tragedy follows that no one saw coming.
Throughout Lisa Nance's five-year marriage to Lester Jones, he'd been violent toward her. But it wasn't until 2016 that she discovered just how dangerous he could be.
When LeAnne Martinez fails to pick up her daughter from her mother's house, her family worries. Her red Mustang is missing, and they find a shocking scene in her home.

Well and truly settled back in Essex, everyone is moving forward with their lives back home - Diags and Jodie are happier than ever and Jodie is spending a lot more time in Essex, but Amber returning from Dubai for good for now comes as a shock to Dan who will now have to navigate co-parenting the dog.
Returning to Capeside after a summer away, Dawson meets an exciting stranger and then comes face to face with Joey. Meanwhile, Jen takes on the head cheerleader.
Phoebe risks her life to destroy an evil warlock who seduced her in a past life, while Piper discovers a romantic conundrum in her past life.
Stephen Mulhern welcomes Aysha as she gets ready to take on the Banker and tries to beat him at his own game.
Rylan Clark-Neal hosts three pairs of shoppers as they compete in a supermarket challenge.

It's a couples' edition as Graham Norton welcomes three pairs - Corinne and Aaron, Quamelle and Adam, and Len and Nancy - all hoping to keep the sparks flying in the studio and take the 50,000-pound prize home.

It's time for double dates as Ella, Dan, Diags and Jodie go out together for the night; the boys are happy that they can go out with their girls together, but Chloe makes a comment at Jordan's party to Dan about Ella that riles the group up.
Ashley and Stacey each attend their divorce mediation appointments with unforeseen outcomes; Keiarna and Greg examine their relationship more closely.

p.t: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
p.d: Garcelle invites the ladies to her beach house; Dorit continues to confide in Boz; Kyle tries to explain herself to Garcelle and Sutton.
Stephen Mulhern hosts a celebrity special of the classic game show with Kate Garraway, Pete Wicks and Sir Bradley Wiggins all trying to 'say what they see' in aid of charity.
Graham Norton welcomes essential skills teacher Orla, development manager Kelly, and events duty officer Ben as they take on puzzles and the iconic Wheel in the hope of winning 50,000 pounds.
Lee Mack returns as 100 more contestants try to make it all the way to the 1% question and win up to £100,000. Will anyone succeed?

A cast of carefully selected housemates from all walks of life take up residence in the world's most famous reality TV home for up to six weeks, with cameras capturing their every move and the nation following every twist and turn.

Get closer to the personalities, dynamics and relationships at the heart of the show. Big Brother legend Kate Lawler and podcaster supreme GK Barry host exclusive interviews with evicted Housemates, celebrity fans and special guests.
Joe takes revenge on Brian for kissing Bonnie. Chris and Meg are caught stealing from the residents at a retirement community.

Morse and Lewis investigate a murder in a quiet country church where a vicar and his voluntary helpers are the unlikely prime suspects. Although at first baffled, Morse pursues his investigations religiously.
A kidnap case leaves Vernon's carefully choreographed wedding plans in chaos, and Merton has to choose between his wife and his career.

A teenage runaway returns home to spend Christmas with her family, but is rejected by her father when she reveals that she has a newborn baby. Vernon's favourite band arrives in Aidensfield to spread some festive cheer - little does he know that they are on the run from the law.
Harper gets a shock after Ken discovers his plans, Mr Rose takes drastic action on a patient with a brain haemorrhage, and Sister Brigid performs a miracle.

Sarah gets a shock when her mum turns up uninvited. Family harmony is disrupted as she interferes with guests, and Sarah feels old wounds reopened. Meanwhile, Danny struggles to settle in an aggressive hippo and Rosie deals with her feelings for Max.

Emmerdale is one of Britain's best-loved and highly viewed long-running drama soaps - set in the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Yorkshire Dales, this realistic and down-to-earth drama superbly chronicles the joys and the heartbreaks of a tightly knit countryside community.
As Simon fights for his life in hospital, Peter pledges never to drink again. Dev is guilt-ridden when Tara returns with an apology, and Fiz arranges to meet Chesney's teacher.
Fiz makes a sudden decision when she learns why Chesney has been avoiding school. Kirk ends his relationship with Julie, and Graeme believes Joshua could be a talented footballer.
Walker must re-visit his shadowy past in order to solve a spate of violent robberies. David is lured into a web of deceit when a stranger arrives in town.
Ventress puts his acting skills to the test when a shipment of stolen Russian icons is smuggled into the area. Vernon is in hot water again when he and David train Alfred to hunt for truffles.
DCI Vera Stanhope must open up a familiar cold case to find the connection between a skeleton discovered underneath the site of a notorious burnt-out nightclub and a present-day murder.

Robert receives some shocking news from the front, Daisy's relationship with William moves faster than she would like, and Bates is taken aback when Vera threatens to expose old secrets which could bring down the Crawleys. Mary is the only one who can protect the family, but she pays a high price when she turns to Carlisle for help.
Syndicate 9's new sergeant has a baptism of fire when their first case is a high profile, historical case. And while Janet keeps Gill's secret, she does share another with Rachel.

After promising that the chaos of her personal life was behind her, Rachel is torn when she discovers that her mother's new boyfriend is a violent domestic abuser. Janet goes on her first date, but gets cold feet at the last minute.

Morse and Lewis investigate a murder in a quiet country church where a vicar and his voluntary helpers are the unlikely prime suspects. Although at first baffled, Morse pursues his investigations religiously.

Emmerdale is one of Britain's best-loved and highly viewed long-running drama soaps - set in the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Yorkshire Dales, this realistic and down-to-earth drama superbly chronicles the joys and the heartbreaks of a tightly knit countryside community.
As Simon fights for his life in hospital, Peter pledges never to drink again. Dev is guilt-ridden when Tara returns with an apology, and Fiz arranges to meet Chesney's teacher.

Walker must re-visit his shadowy past in order to solve a spate of violent robberies. David is lured into a web of deceit when a stranger arrives in town.
Ventress puts his acting skills to the test when a shipment of stolen Russian icons is smuggled into the area. Vernon is in hot water again when he and David train Alfred to hunt for truffles.
DCI Vera Stanhope must open up a familiar cold case to find the connection between a skeleton discovered underneath the site of a notorious burnt-out nightclub and a present-day murder.

Robert receives some shocking news from the front, Daisy's relationship with William moves faster than she would like, and Bates is taken aback when Vera threatens to expose old secrets which could bring down the Crawleys. At the Domo Boutique Hotel, owner Ali and his friend Serge expect their luxury lodgings to impress their fellow competitors. Helen is dazzled by the décor, but a caffeine conundrum leads to some trouble brewing, including disastrous drinks.

At The Crown Inn, in Gayton, Norfolk, Lisa and Neil hope their historic setting and boutique-style rooms will win over their guests. But there are 'paneful' observations about the cleanliness of the windows, and a lorry-load of noise.
On the final day, the B&Bers discover what they've been paid, and a winner is announced. But comments about curtains and off-colour feedback about bedding leave some hosts open-mouthed.

The first to host in Essex is support worker and party girl Emma Parsons. Emma reckons she can win the competition on personality alone, and hopes that her tried and tested menu and school uniform dress code will put her top of the class.

Adam James is next to host in Essex. The confident letting agent pops to the local salon to top up his tan before he starts cooking, only to get into a muddle in the kitchen later while his guests admire his hunky photos on his wall.

Hairdressing teacher and entrepreneur Lisa Styles is planning to woo her guests in Essex at her mansion situated in eight acres of land. There will be butlers and Lisa's prize-winning stallion performing a show jump for the guest's amusement.

It's day four in Essex and the turn of family man Hal Dervish to host. Hal is planning six different dishes for his meze starter, and four different meats for his main of traditional Turkish barbecue.

It's the final night in Essex and the turn of posh magistrate Diane Whittaker to treat her four guests to a night of culinary delights. Diane hopes to inject a little sophistication into the competition by hosting a black tie event.
At Hazel's Roost in Bainbridge, Yorkshire, Lithuanian-raised host Millie Bussey hopes her years working on cruise ships will mean the competition is all plain sailing.
The second visit this week is to Llanymynech in Wales, where at Rhandregynwen Hall even host Mark Johannsen and his friend Amos Bell are stumped by the B&B's name.

The third visit of the week is to the Smart and Simple hotel in Tunbridge Wells, Kent. Owner Simon Colbran and his assistant manager Rebecca Heasman want their rivals to agree that 'the rooms are smart, and that's simple'.
The final visit of the week is to Pearfield B&B in Petersfield, where owner Cathy Robinson and her son Alex want to win over their guests with a home from home experience.

It's the final day, and the B&Bers meet for the last time to discuss their feedback forms and see how much they've been paid. With low scoring and hurt feelings, there's plenty of tension before the winner is revealed.

p.t: Did They Really Do That? Top 30
p.d: Thirty fabulously great, but awful, chart hits and videos - all with that certain cringe factor attached. Did they really do that? They certainly did.
45 minutes of back to back number 1s from 1972 - from The New Seekers to Little Jimmy Osmond via My Ding-a-Ling! With Mr Charts himself - Mark Goodier.
Classic hits from just 1 year - 1976!
Blimey, what a year! Get ready to turn your telly up LOUD, with the greatest party anthems from '72 including Bowie, Slade, The Sweet and The Osmonds. Don't forget your Ding-a-Ling!
Today we'd call it Cheesy Pop! Back then it was Bubblegum Pop & TISWAS Sally has a prime selection including David Cassidy, Mungo Jerry, Lynsey De Paul, Tony Orlando & The Osmonds.
Rewind to a time of big hair, outrageous makeup and platform shoes. The greatest gems of glam pop and rock, including Queen, ABBA and Wizzard.
Find out who our biggest superstar showoffs of the decade are. Featuring Sting, Meat Loaf, Iggy, Freddie, Geldof, Jagger, Rod and Daltrey for starters.
Non-stop 70s songs the cool kids were listening to in the latter half of the decade, expect skinny jeans, safety pins, guitars and just a few snarls.
Paul Young, who has sung one or two himself, brings you 25 classic '80s hits that were all covers, including Whitney, Madness, Billy Idol and Simply Red. Some will really surprise you!
Lesser known songs you may have forgotten from artists you'll certainly know!

The rugged coast of the USA's biggest state harbours some incredible wildlife. When winter breaks, animals make the most of the nightless summer.
Casey examines the controversial wolf reintroduction at Yellowstone Park and ventures 'inside the pack' to create an intriguing profile of the park's apex predator.
It's a tough day at the clinic for all-species vet Dr Michelle Oakley. Plus, when a string of house visits get scary two people wind up in hospital.
Dr Michelle Oakley makes her annual 500-mile trek to help Alaska's newborn reindeer and moose. She also takes on a ferocious wolverine.
A python with killer back pain, a shy lion, and a bear with a gnarly cough.
Discover the deadly techniques employed by the orcas of Valdez Bay, the only pod of orcas in the world who strand themselves to kill their prey.

Suspecting an unusual diet, scientists investigate the gigantic tiger sharks of Norfolk Island. Biologists Lauren Meyers, Charlie Huveneers and Adam Barnett lure the giants to their boat and make a surprising discovery.
Charleston, South Carolina, has long been renowned as the jewel of the American South, but the popular summer destination became known for something else after five terrifying shark attacks.
As the weather warms up, the homesteaders shift from survival mode to "thrival" mode.
The will to survive is a powerful force, and nobody goes down without a fight. But in Africa, sometimes animals just behave badly.

In Western Australia, the Heli Hunters are forced to make an emergency landing in remote country. The Brumbies can't seem to catch a break. While in Victoria, Nev leads the Poseidon Crew to a secret patch in big nugget country.
Mark devises a costly solution when the excavator that almost took his life breaks down. Lee and Roger's old rumbler refuses to fire up.
A road trip to Diggers Gully pays off for the Opal Lovers. Taking a gamble on their Turners Rush claim doesn't seem to be paying off for the Cheals.

Toy restorers Julie and Amanda welcome a stuffed monkey called Midge into the barn. Owner Charles received the toy primate as a Christmas present in the 1960s, but when he turned 14, his market trader dad put Midge to work on his Barnsley Market stall. To attract shoppers, the monkey hung from the stall whilst an invisible pulley waved his hand.

Henry Cole and Fuzz Townshend travel from Cornwall to Oxfordshire to rummage around in some of Britain's most amazing sheds in search of a nice little earner. Their discoveries include vintage tractors, engines and a clutch of historic motorbikes.

Henry and Sam are rummaging again. They meet Phil in sunny Buckinghamshire, where they find stationary engines, traction engines and vintage petrol cans, but is there anything for the boys to restore and flog?

Henry and his ace mechanic mate Sam Lovegrove are in Surrey where they find Pontiac ambulances, mysterious automotive sculptures, and strangely well-preserved motorbikes. Later, in Cornwall, they meet a collector whose cottage is like a transport museum, chock-full with memorabilia, penny farthings and lights of all description.

Bike guru Henry Cole and ace mechanic Sam Lovegrove are off to Cornwall. They meet a collector whose cottage is like a transport museum, chock-full with memorabilia, penny farthings and lights of all description.

p.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
p.d: Henry Cole and Simon O'Brien head to Redditch where Henry restores a 70s Kawasaki motorbike, while Simon takes a pair of rusty cinema seat supports and creates a desirable garden bench.
Angus helps a woman turn her collection into a mind-boggling sum at auction, and he has an opportunity to score with some rare football memorabilia.

Angus visits a home littered with a variety of antiques and curios including a map from the American Civil War, and another home that is chock-full of portraits, furniture and a whisky collection that's been gathering dust for decades.

Charlie and Izzie continue their B Road romp, pointing their classic car to Surrey. Gemmologist Izzie finds a piece of jewellery that causes quite a stir at auction. And Charlie's passion for furniture in all shades of brown sees him uncover a very rare table that sparks a frenzy of bids at the Dorking auction.
Ant is in Essex to see a car that was fit for the Queen, a 1970 Rover P5B. The V8 wins him over, but rust, oil leaks and heavy steering spell trouble.

Vinnie gives the Rag 'n' Bone man a tour of his countryside empire where the pair discuss the highs and lows of life in the limelight and dealing with fame. There's an urgent aerator problem at the lakes and Vinnie risks losing £20k's worth of trout.

Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life. Art conservator Lucia Scalisi has to draw on all of her 30 years of experience to repair a much-loved landscape that has been left hanging together by a few threads of canvas after a house move mishap.

Stacey needs a last-minute stunner for her reception, but she's not convinced that she'll have an emotional reaction to an off-the-rack dress. Shaela is blind, but she knows what kind of dress she wants and just needs her mum to see her vision.

Twenty four-year-old Alice Ruggles was a bright young woman who had everything to live for, until she met Lance Corporal Harry Dhillon. After a short-lived romance, Alice ended the relationship in the summer of 2016, whereupon Dhillon commenced his reign of stalking and threats, culminating in one final act of terror on the evening of the 12th October 2016.
In 2009, young mother Nixiann Downes-Clack went missing from her home island in Grenada in the Caribbean. Her family speak about the desperate search they had to undertake to find her.

p.t: On the Case With Paula Zahn
p.d: Painful questions torment a loving husband after his wife's brutal murder; in particular, the community's doubts about whether he had been her killer.
The discovery of a burnt body sends police on the hunt for camera footage that may reveal what happened.
When Andrea Farrington meets colleague Alex Kozak she thinks romance is possible. However, soon suspicion and fear take over, leading to a rejection with fatal consequences.
Joy and Fred are high school sweethearts until a tragic work accident changes the course of their lives. As Joy tries to find a second shot at love, she confronts a heartbreaking tragedy.
In Knoxville, Tennessee, a seemingly perfect couple were secretly living a nightmare. The wife was found guilty of soliciting her new partner to kill her former husband.
Bodycam video captures the hunt for a madman who unleashed a six-person killing spree upon the Scottsdale, Arizona area over the course of 96 hours.
Following the case of a shocking stabbing as a result of a so-called 'honour killing' and the tragic story of a four-year-old who was the victim of a hit-and-run.
A teenage girl disappears from a Kansas Mall. The only clue for detectives - the haunting final images of her on surveillance video.
One winter evening, a mother doesn't return home from work. When dawn breaks, her body is discovered in a churchyard. See if CCTV footage can reveal the killer.

In Florida, desperate to stop a dangerous carjacking suspect, officers chase him through busy downtown; in Wisconsin, officers rush to save victims of a brutal mass stabbing, launching a manhunt to track the suspect before he can strike again.
Two police officers respond to a domestic disturbance that ends in tragedy. Plus, a terrifying house fire takes a disturbing turn when it becomes a murder investigation.
A 22-year-old nursing assistant vanishes. When police check the local CCTV footage, they discover that Carlesha Freeland-Gaither was abducted right on camera.
Meet the ocean's most formidable predator. Uncover the biology behind its survival across extinctions and the lethal hunting skills of bull sharks.

Rajan is the powerful alpha male who sits at the head of an unusually large troop, but the future does not look so bright. While he has done well to sustain such a big group, there are more mouths to feed in a shrinking jungle home.

The team contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys while vet nurse Nick hunts for natural remedies to treat a wallaby's gut ailment. Elsewhere, the staff ponder a stuck baby bat, and vet Karina operates on a barn owl's fractured wing.
Capuchin Louis makes the most out of being let outside for the first time - playing a game of hide and sneak with Donna. Slow loris Bruce gets Botox.
Alison receives footage of a pet Tamarin monkey in need of a home, Bruce the loris gets a check-up and golden-cheeked gibbons Kim and Tien get cosy.
Known for jaw-dropping encounters with giant Pacific manta rays, hammerhead schools, dolphins, and tiger sharks, Socorro Island is a tiny volcanic jewel that has been called the Mexican Galápagos.
Hope tries to make two orphaned bobcats into playmates - with mixed results, 100 patients are ready for release and a rare bird makes a brief visit.

All Stella wants is take over her small, family run restaurant in the U.S. and marry her long-term boyfriend. However, when everything she thought was certain falls apart, she takes an opening for a chef in a new London restaurant.
Mrs. Miracle uses Christmas magic to reunite three siblings who must decide who will inherit the family's real estate empire, following their grandmother's passing.

p.t: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: A Tale of Three Letters
p.d: The Postables try to identify the intended recipients of a trio of dead letters which have a surprising, personal impact on all of them.

Kate is a blogger, specialist in romantic relationships. When she is offered a column in a major New York daily, she enters into competition with Joseph, a dating agent, creator of a revolutionary algorithm.
Lacey is an amusement park princess who befriends eight-year-old Rose, a real-life princess and is recruited by her handsome father to travel to their kingdom and be the new governess.
Contest winners try to solve a fake murder for a grand prize, but the event goes awry when a real murder occurs and secrets are uncovered.
Former dancer Luna pairs up with Bennett, a world-class aerialist, when he finds himself without a partner for his upcoming performance at the local arts festival.

Sophie is a rising culinary star on the verge of becoming executive chef at a high-end Manhattan restaurant. But when her sister Abigail calls with news that their beloved family seafood restaurant is floundering, Sophie returns home to help.

p.t: Mujer, casos de la vida real: Edición especial
p.d: Una edición especial sobre el programa de historias verdaderas enviadas por el público a la actriz Silvia Pinal. Temas de interés general que son censurados por la sociedad.

La doctora Ana María Polo interviene en batallas legales que afectan a los latinos. Como en una corte, las partes presentan testigos y evidencias para que ella emita su decisión. Además, expertos contribuyen con sus conocimientos.
Una condena injusta cambia la vida de Alejandro Gaitán y lo separa de la mujer que ama, Mariana Zambrano. En prisión, se convierte en otra persona y regresa, 17 años más tarde, para vengarse.

Grisel y Angelica, más que amigas, tras un pacto, hermanas. Dos adolescentes, buscando su lugar en la vida, son deslumbradas por la intensa y fugaz presencia de su primer gran amor, Pablo, una estrella de las redes sociales.
Maite y Diego se conocen en un bar y comienzan una relación, pero él tiene novia y Maite lo descubre. Diego le pide otra oportunidad, pero ella duda si debe aceptar o no.

A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

Esta relación le da a Yolanda mucho poder, pero también es su pesadilla cuando sale en libertad.

Los casos más controversiales y las disputas de las familias latinas que se resolverán con base a las leyes.
Nayeli busca una oportunidad de trabajo como contadora, pero debido a su apariencia nadie la toma en serio. Por eso, quiere demostrar que es inteligente y no solo una cara bonita.

Un extraño señor llega a la vecindad buscando a Doña Clotilde y le dice que una pariente muerta suya le heredó toda una fortuna. El Chavo es testigo y le dice a los niños, pero el Profesor Jirafales no le cree.
A Quico le comienzan a salir manchas negras por todo su cuerpo; el Chavo piensa que Quico se está transformando en un perro dálmata.
Alejandra descubre que está embarazada, no saben cómo lo tomará la familia. Chris y su pareja han decidido adoptar a un bebé.
Luis debe recurrir a remedios extremos para poder continuar con su labor de venta. Rocco está dispuesto a fugarse de la prisión.
Una mujer se asusta de un ratón y decide llamar al Chapulín Colorado para que la ayude a cazarlo. Sin embargo, él decide contarle la historia de un famoso ratón, Topo Gigio.
Don Ramón y doña Florinda quieren ir a una fiesta, pero no saben con quién dejar a su bebé, hasta que deciden pedirle ayuda al Chapulín Colorado.

A doña Clotilde se le quema la pancita que le preparaba a don Ramón. Él la auxilia para que no se queme y, en agradecimiento, ella le hará unas exquisitas quesadillas de pancita. Al llevar lo prometido, la Chilindrina y el Chavo hacen una travesura.

El señor Barriga le pide a don Ramón que deje el departamento cuanto antes por su falta de pago. El Chavo y Quico encuentran un álbum de fotos y se sorprenden al ver que Don Ramón era un gran boxeador.
Patricia le dice a Berenice que vio a Laura con Macario. Berenice le exige a Regina que eche a Macario de la hacienda, pero ella se niega.

Betty y Verónica visitan a la mamá de Karla para ofrecerle ayuda y ella termina echándoles la culpa de lo que le pasa a su hija. Miranda le expone a Teodoro las razones por las que ha vuelto. Verónica está decidida a impedir la boda.

Santos Martínez de la Garza y Treviño es un joven guapo a quien la fortuna le ha sonreído siempre. Nació en Monterrey y desde los cinco años vive en EE. UU. Es dueño de una agencia automotriz, donde conoce a María, con quien tiene un romance.

Severiano del Monte vive con sus cinco hijos adoptivos, pero ante un fallecimiento, la vida de sus hijos cambia el día de la lectura del testamento, con la aparición inesperada de Sara, su hermana, de cuya existencia no sabían.

Los equipos se enfrentan nuevamente con toda la actitud y ganas de ganar. Cada participante tiene claro que su estancia en el juego depende de sus habilidades y destreza en las pistas. Todos se esfuerzan al máximo para conservar su lugar.
Programa que muestra diversos productos para la venta.
Programa que muestra diversos productos para la venta.
Programa que muestra diversos productos para la venta.
Programa que muestra diversos productos para la venta.
Los casos más controversiales y las disputas de las familias latinas que se resolverán con base a las leyes.
Nayeli busca una oportunidad de trabajo como contadora, pero debido a su apariencia nadie la toma en serio. Por eso, quiere demostrar que es inteligente y no solo una cara bonita.

Un extraño señor llega a la vecindad buscando a Doña Clotilde y le dice que una pariente muerta suya le heredó toda una fortuna. El Chavo es testigo y le dice a los niños, pero el Profesor Jirafales no le cree.
A Quico le comienzan a salir manchas negras por todo su cuerpo; el Chavo piensa que Quico se está transformando en un perro dálmata.
Alejandra descubre que está embarazada, no saben cómo lo tomará la familia. Chris y su pareja han decidido adoptar a un bebé.
Luis debe recurrir a remedios extremos para poder continuar con su labor de venta. Rocco está dispuesto a fugarse de la prisión.
Una mujer se asusta de un ratón y decide llamar al Chapulín Colorado para que la ayude a cazarlo. Sin embargo, él decide contarle la historia de un famoso ratón, Topo Gigio.
Don Ramón y doña Florinda quieren ir a una fiesta, pero no saben con quién dejar a su bebé, hasta que deciden pedirle ayuda al Chapulín Colorado.

A doña Clotilde se le quema la pancita que le preparaba a don Ramón. Él la auxilia para que no se queme y, en agradecimiento, ella le hará unas exquisitas quesadillas de pancita. Al llevar lo prometido, la Chilindrina y el Chavo hacen una travesura.

El señor Barriga le pide a don Ramón que deje el departamento cuanto antes por su falta de pago. El Chavo y Quico encuentran un álbum de fotos y se sorprenden al ver que Don Ramón era un gran boxeador.
Un francotirador al que no han logrado identificar dispara contra un candidato a la alcaldía. El equipo trata de encontrar y arrestar al francotirador antes de que cometa otro atentado.

Se enciende un debate ético cuando un paciente se niega a hacerse una prueba de VIH, pero igual desea recibir tratamiento. Natalie y Will tratan de diagnosticar a una pequeña niña con parálisis. Noah lidia con su primera muerte como residente.

Ethan trata de diagnosticar a un paciente sin síntomas. Sarah usa gas pimienta contra un paciente agresivo. Will trata a una pareja que sacrificaría todo por tener un bebé. Natalie debe dar a una mujer la noticia de que fue esterilizada.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Una prometedora cantante es golpeada por su novio, una famosa estrella de hip-hop, pero ella se niegan a ayudar a ADA Barba a construir su caso; el acusado y su abogado vuelven el caso en un circo de medios.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Una mujer dice que Brian Cassidy (Dean Winters) la violó mientras él estuvo trabajando encubierto; cuando Cassidy y su abogado utilizan métodos de defensa sorprendentes, el detective Amaro es afectado.
El Dr. Charles se ve presionado cuando el Dr. Choi y el Dr. Manning no están de acuerdo con su decisión médica con respecto a un bebé nacido con una adicción a la heroína.

El Dr. Choi lucha para ayudar a una mujer a sobrellevar la anorexia. Después de una suspensión, el Dr. Charles inmediatamente pone a prueba al Dr. Reese. Un paciente del Dr. Rhodes es transferido por la fuerza.
Boden une a su equipo después del desastre de la explosión. Casey trabaja para encontrar a Severide. Newhouse trae noticias sobre uno de los parientes de Mills.
Severide regresa al trabajo. Mills descubre más información sobre la familia de su padre. Hermann le pide ideas para ayudar al negocio.

Los camiones de la estación de bomberos 51 y de Austin chocan en el camino a atender una llamada. A Boden se le ocurre un plan para que Dawson obtenga su insignia. Mills se enfrenta a su pasado y al futuro.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Benson trata de ayudar a una estrella del pop que está en una relación violenta. Rollins trata de no llevar a su casa el estrés del trabajo. Fin le da una lección a un novato sobre el respeto a sus colegas.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Un allanamiento de morada y un secuestro llevan a la unidad a un descubrimiento impactante. Muncy intenta encajar en el equipo.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Un joven pide ayuda al equipo cuando sospecha que su jefe se está aprovechando de su hermana. Velasco intenta convencer a un testigo reticente para que testifique ante el tribunal.
Ruzek toma una decisión que pone en riesgo su vida y su carrera para proteger a sus seres queridos; Inteligencia investiga el robo de un auto relacionado con un homicidio.

Inteligencia se topa con un candidato a la alcaldía, mientras investiga el asesinato de un conocido abogado defensor. Antonio vuelve al trabajo, pero empieza a cuestionar si está preparado cuando una operación sale mal.
Francia, 1956. El asesinato de un sacerdote provoca que un mal demoníaco se extienda sin control. La hermana Irene deberá enfrentarse, de nuevo, a la monja satánica Valak.
Un hombre y su esposa ignoran que a cada uno, como asesino internacional, se le ha asignado matar al otro.

El detective Bruce Kenner viaja a Minnesota para investigar el caso de la joven Ángela, que acusa a su padre, John, de haber cometido un crimen inconfesable. John admite la autoría del crimen sin recordar nada de lo sucedido.

p.t: La verdad sobre la inteligencia artificial
p.d: A medida que las computadoras continúen evolucionando a una velocidad cada vez mayor, alcanzarán la capacidad de diseñar y programar por sí mismas.
Un detective aficionado roba una máquina capaz de grabar, almacenar y mostrar los recuerdos de otra persona para resolver con ella el enigma de quién asesinó al inventor de este artilugio.

Cada semana, Kable, un reo condenado a muerte, lucha contra sus compañeros de prisión en un violento juego en línea llamado "Asesinos" en el que todos los movimientos son controlados de forma remota. Los jugadores, Kable y los otros reos son solamente personajes simulados, pero, para el grupo de resistencia que se opone al inventor del juego, Kable es un componente crítico de su plan para terminar con la esclavitud tecnológica del inventor.
Un escritor enloquece mientras trabaja como cuidador, junto con su esposa e hijo clarividente, en un hotel de Colorado que está bloqueado por la nieve.
Una joven familia es visitada por los fantasmas en su casa. Al principio, los espíritus parecen amigables, pero luego se vuelven desagradables y empiezan a aterrorizar a la familia.

Cuando los tesoros más grandes del mundo, incluido el diamante de la Pantera Rosa, son robados, solamente un hombre puede resolver el misterio: Clouseau. Junto con su compañero Ponton y un equipo de detectives internacionales, el inepto detective debe atrapar al ladrón y recuperar los artefactos, sin provocar muchos daños colaterales en el proceso.
Cuento sobre la búsqueda de una chica por su hermano menor que está atrapado en el reino místico de un rey de duendes.

p.t: El hombre de la máscara de hierro
p.d: Ex mosqueteros tratan de derrocar al tiránico rey Luis XIV y utilizan a su encarcelado hermano gemelo en su plan.
Un estudiante de la Ivy League y las actividades delictivas de un productor de música se descubren cuando un fracasado negocio de drogas conduce al asesinato.

Cuando una madre y sus dos hijas no llegan a la cena navideña, agentes de la policía entran en su casa: las encuentran a las tres muertas. La búsqueda del asesino revelará una pesadilla familiar nunca antes vista.
Un avance científico conduce a un asesinato a sangre fría. Un plan de financiación construido sobre una red de mentiras está en peligro de ser descubierto.
Un ladrón de bancos declarado culpable encuentra la felicidad con una prometida indulgente. Sin embargo, su pasado criminal lo condena a vivir circunstancias extremas.

Justo antes de Año Nuevo, una madre es asesinada en la puerta de su casa; esa misma noche, encuentran siete cadáveres en otra casa; la policía descubre una conexión sorprendente entre los dos crímenes.
La criminóloga Imette St. Guillen había dedicado su vida a capturar asesinos, hasta que, mientras celebraba su cumpleaños una noche, en Manhattan, fue uno de ellos quien la atrapó a ella.
La exnovia del autoproclamado Caníbal de la Ballesta revela los abusos mentales y físicos que sufrió durante años a manos de uno de los asesinos en serie más atroces del Reino Unido.
La segunda esposa de un padre de familia muere en la bañera. La policía investiga de nuevo la muerte de la primera esposa y el hijo descubre que su padre es un asesino.
Un baño de sangre en una mansión de Beverly Hills destapa los terribles secretos de una familia cuyos miembros aparentaban disfrutar de una vida idílica que en realidad no tenían.
El descubrimiento de un cadáver quemado junto a la carretera impulsa una carrera para encontrar al asesino.
Asaltan un restaurante y asesinan al gerente nocturno, lo que lleva a la policía a investigar a compañeros de trabajo sospechosos, a un ex empleado descontento y a un violento atacante en serie.
Los detectives investigan un romance secreto, un complot de secuestro y una pandilla racista cuando encuentran a un joven, que estaba a punto de casarse, baleado y apuñalado.
Los oscuros deseos sexuales de una pareja la conducen a una serie de ataques que se vuelven cada vez más espantosos al empeorar las cosas.
En el desierto de México, dos líderes de secta con una pasión por la tortura y el sacrificio humano son revelados cuando eligen a la víctima equivocada.
Cuando encuentran el cuerpo de un abogado exitoso en un canal del sur de Florida, los detectives usan tecnología innovadora para seguir los horribles pasos de un asesino malvado.
Gunter ordena a sus hombres permitir la entrada a Worms a unos guerreros desconocidos. Hagen advierte que uno de sus acompañantes es el elfo oscuro Alberich.

House y el equipo, más Cuddy, atienden a una adolescente con obesidad que se desmaya durante la fiesta de Navidad de su preparatoria. Foreman y Trece continúan trabajando en el tratamiento del Huntington. Cuddy recibe un regalo inesperado.

House y el equipo toman el caso de un hombre que intenta suicidarse a causa de un dolor insoportable. Cuddy descubre que cuidar de un bebé es un desafío para la organización de su tiempo. Trece y Foreman inician una relación.

Cuddy delega algunas responsabilidades a Cameron, incluyendo vigilar a House. El equipo trata el caso de una maestra de educación especial que se desmaya tras escupir sangre durante una clase. Foreman debe tomar una arriesgada decisión sobre Trece.

Mientras atienden a una ex investigadora de cáncer que abandonó su carrera para buscar su propia felicidad personal, House y su equipo empiezan a cuestionarse sus decisiones. Trece empieza a mostrar serias reacciones a su tratamiento experimental.

Un sacerdote es admitido en el hospital tras ver a Jesús sangrando frente a la puerta de su casa. House suma el caso como una distracción para el equipo, mientras se involucra en la relación de Trece y Foreman.

El equipo trata el caso de un niño que no está al tanto de que posee ADN masculino y femenino, y sus padres decidieron su género al momento de nacer. Wilson y Cuddy creen que algo está mal con House cuando empieza a comportarse amablemente.

Mientras el equipo trabaja en el rescate de un niño de cinco años que fue secuestrado, Scola sospecha que la madre del niño no está siendo sincera sobre por qué su hijo era el objetivo. Nina sufre tratando de ser sincera con Scola.

Maggie regresa y ayuda al equipo a investigar dos homicidios: el de un estudiante y el de un joven con posibles vínculos con criminales. Una revelación de Maggie provoca que OA sospeche que ha vuelto demasiado rápido al trabajo.

Un atraco mortal a un camión arma a los asesinos con suficiente nitrato de amonio para construir una bomba superdestructiva. El equipo descubre un vínculo con un grupo terrorista en el que Maggie está trabajando para infiltrarse.

Kellett y el equipo se unen a regañadientes a una investigación en Irlanda del Norte, cuando uno de los informantes de Kellett es arrestado por su conexión con un robo y asesinato, y la llama para ayudar a limpiar su nombre.
Edmond localiza a Gastón, el hijo ilegítimo de Villefort, que se ha convertido en ladrón. Danglars descubre las traiciones de Fernand en Argelia y lo revela todo a la prensa.

El grupo terrorista Voltov secuestra a la microbióloga Rachel Moss y la obliga a crear un arma biológica letal. Zara y Vincent ven cómo su misión rutinaria de vigilancia en Bengasi se convierte en una carrera contrarreloj para impedir la propagación del virus antes de que provoque consecuencias devastadoras a nivel mundial.

Un ataque brutal impide que Zara recopile información crucial en Londres. Ella se da cuenta de que alguien dentro del MI6 está filtrando información a Voltov. En Bengasi, Vincent y Rachel son tomados como rehenes por Voltov, y Vincent le promete a Rachel que la ayudará a escapar.
Ava, Nathan y Matt asisten a una convención de crímenes reales. Un ponente sorpresa amenaza el futuro del pódcast. Nathan tiene una crisis moral.
Luis comienza a molestar a Silvia todo el tiempo queriendo controlar lo que hace para cuidar del bebé. Magdalena invierte todo su dinero en una empresa fantasma y pierde todo.

Un repaso de las noticias ocurridas hasta el final el día. Tiene la información completa de las noticias de último minuto y registra con las cámaras desde el lugar de los hechos para que la audiencia quede bien informada antes de terminar el día.
Erika lleva a cabo sus planes para alejar a Fernanda de Eduardo. Cándido lleva a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de Vladímir. Natasha tiene celos al saber que Camilo se ha comprometido con Venus.

El hijo de Silvia y Luis no para de llorar y ya no saben qué hacer. Los vecinos les aconsejan cómo cuidar al bebé mientras Germán improvisa un gimnasio en el vestíbulo.

Diana recibe la visita de su padre, quien le dice que fue a buscarla para que regrese a su casa. Don Clemente, a su vez, le dice que está orgulloso de ella.

La historia de seis parejas que tienen dificultades en sus matrimonios y los problemas que tienen que enfrentar día a día; las esposas que luchan por sacar adelante el hogar tratando de equilibrar su vida hogareña con sus trabajos.
A los 17 años, Rina queda viuda y millonaria. Su cuñada Rafaela trama un plan para casarla con su hijo Carlos Augusto para despojarla de su fortuna.

Paula Bernal y Rogelio Iturbide son dos personas con vidas muy distintas que, al conocerse, deciden casarse sin avisar a la familia de Rogelio, en especial a la matriarca de la familia, Martina Rangel.
Un juez contrata a una joven humilde para que trabaje como tutora de su hijo rebelde y ella se gana el afecto de ambos.

Desesperada por encontrar empleo, una chica nada atractiva, se coloca como secretaria en la compañía Conceptos. Lety se enamora perdidamente de su jefe, pero ignora las razones por las cuales Fernando intenta seducirla y engañar a su bella prometida.

Diana empieza con labor de parto y Paz la lleva al hospital. Consuelo intenta convencer a Victor de que desista del divorcio, le dice que el bienestar de sus hijas solo les importa a ellos, él la ignora.

Rogelio invita a los hermanos Coraje para agradecer que Juan le salvó la vida a Clara y olvidar el pasado. Falcón le cuenta su historia a Jackie y le dice que algún día las tierras de Rogelio serán suyas. Juan no confía en el cambio de Rogelio.

Madjavi ahorra para comprar un boleto para ver a Cindy en concierto, pero Cindy decide retirarse de la fama justo cuando Madjavi consigue su boleto. Ahora, Madjavi está dispuesta a exigirle a Cindy el reembolso.
Pedro y Benito quieren que alguno de los vecinos reemplace a Germán como portero en su equipo, pero Germán cree que le quieren quitar su trabajo.

Federica se encuentra a su amiga Columba y las indirectas entre ellas no se hacen esperar; Federica quiere vengarse de que Columba y Basilio les ganaron en el dominó, los invitan a una fiesta, pero ellos a cambio de ir les piden varios favores.

Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

Alan le ofrece ayuda a Charlie para recuperar a su mucama Berta, si él consigue que Jake se aliste a tiempo para cenar con su madre.
Charlie y Allan asisten a un partido de fútbol de Jake y descubren que es una manera fácil de conocer a madres solteras.
Después de que Evelyn termina con su nuevo pretendiente, Charlie y Alan le piden ayuda a Jake para que la anime. Además, Charlie le enseña a Jake a desviar llamadas telefónicas de mujeres.
